title: AVP: Principal Engineer (DSG Scale)
description:
Business Unit: Data Strategy Group Industry: No Industry Overview Houlihan Lokey, Inc. (NYSE:HLI) is a leading global investment bank recognized for delivering independent strategic and financial advice to corporations, financial sponsors, and governments. With uniquely deep industry expertise, broad international reach, and a partnership approach rooted in trust, the firm provides innovative, integrated solutions across mergers and acquisitions, capital solutions, financial restructuring, and financial and valuation advisory. Our unmatched transaction volumes provide differentiated, data-driven perspectives that help our clients achieve their most critical goals. To learn more about Houlihan Lokey, please visit HL.com. Scope We are seeking a highly accomplished Principal Engineer to serve as the technical authority and architectural leader for our cloud-native platform and infrastructure within the Financial Platform organization. In this role, you will define the platform architecture roadmap, design mission-critical infrastructure patterns, and lead the technical execution of platforms that power large-scale, distributed financial applications. Key Responsibilities Platform Architecture & Strategic Direction: Define and drive the target-state architecture for our next-generation, cloud-native platform (Kubernetes, multi-region cloud topologies, and AI/workload enablement). Translate overarching business goals into scalable, resilient, and decoupled platform capabilities. Modern Web & End-to-End Automation with Playwright: Standardize and implement Playwright for modern browser and web application automation, utilizing browser context isolation, parallel test execution, request interception, and resilient auto-waiting mechanisms for frontend platform portals. Automated Regression, Integrated & Functional Testing: Architect and drive automated testing frameworks across the platform lifecycle, establishing continuous automated regression suites across CI/CD environments, multi-service integrated testing across distributed microservices and event brokers, and end-to-end functional automated tests validating complex financial workflows and edge cases. Hands-On Core Engineering: Lead by example by writing production-grade code, building foundational custom tooling/operators (Typescript, Python), authoring reusable Terraform modules, and designing reference implementations for engineering teams. Technical Leadership & Mentorship: Serve as a mentor and technical coach to junior and mid-level engineers. Facilitate design reviews, establish architecture RFC processes, conduct deep code/infrastructure reviews, and foster a strong culture of engineering excellence. Enterprise CI/CD & Developer Experience (DevEx): Architect automated, self-service golden paths and progressive delivery pipelines (canary, blue-green) that minimize cognitive load for application developers while ensuring strict deployment guardrails. Observability, SRE & Chaos Engineering: Design holistic telemetry strategies utilizing OpenTelemetry. Define enterprise SLI/SLO standards, error budget policies, resilience testing/chaos engineering, and lead complex root-cause analyses (RCA) for critical production incidents. 
 Basic Qualifications Experience: 7+ years of hands-on experience in Platform Engineering, QA Automation, SRE, Distributed Systems, or Cloud Architecture, with a proven track record of designing and operating large-scale, production-grade distributed systems. Architecture & System Design: Demonstrated expertise in architecting complex, highly available, fault-tolerant, and secure cloud topologies (AWS, Azure, or GCP). Automated Test Engineering Mastery: Demonstrated proficiency in architecting automated regression, integration, and functional test frameworks; extensive hands-on experience with Playwright for web/UI testing and modern API testing tools. Security, Auth & Impersonation Validation: Hands-on experience testing and validating authentication/authorization modules (OAuth2, OIDC, JWT), RBAC access matrices, and user impersonation security logic. Infrastructure-as-Code Mastery: Mid-level proficiency with Terraform (custom provider/module development, state locking, drift detection) and Policy-as-Code engines (e.g., OPA, Rego, Kyverno). Mentorship & Influence: Proven track record of guiding junior engineers, driving engineering consensus across disparate teams, and leading technical initiatives without direct authority. Observability & Reliability: Hands-on experience with modern observability platforms, distributed tracing with OpenTelemetry, Prometheus/Grafana ecosystems, and enterprise SRE practices. Education: Bachelor s or Master s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. Preferred Qualifications Experience architecting platforms within highly regulated domains (e.g., Financial Services, FinTech, Banking). Deep experience with Securing Cloud Native Platform. Experience designing, building, or operating large-scale Data Platforms is highly desirable. Active contributions to open-source cloud-native projects (CNCF ecosystem). title: Sr Manager - Risk Management (Merchant Operations)
description:
You Lead the Way. We ve Got Your Back. At American Express, our culture is built on a long history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviours, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. We operate with a strong risk mindset while continuously improving how we serve merchants and manage critical business processes. Here, your voice and ideas matter, your work makes an impact, and together we help define the future of American Express. How Will You Make Impact in this Role. Merchant Account Operations & Resilience supports critical merchant-data, operational-risk, remediation, and transformation activities. Accurate merchant data and effective operational processes are essential to pricing, servicing, risk management, reporting, and decision-making. The Senior Manager, Risk Management will lead a team focused on Merchant Hierarchy process transformation, enterprise remediation, and strategic program delivery . The role will identify opportunities to simplify and uplift hierarchy review processes using AI, automation, analytics, workflow solutions, and operating-model improvements. It will also lead or support complex remediation and cross-functional programs by bringing strong governance, execution discipline, change management, and leadership visibility. The successful candidate will combine operational experience, program leadership, analytical fluency, transformation thinking, stakeholder management and people leadership. The role will partner closely with teams responsible for ongoing Merchant Hierarchy governance and day-to-day hierarchy reviews. Minimum Qualifications: Experience leading complex, cross-functional programs in a global or highly matrixed organization. Strong program-governance capability across planning, ownership, dependencies, risk management, escalation, and outcome measurement. Experience within operations, servicing, risk, controls, remediation, transformation, or another operationally intensive environment. Demonstrated ability to identify and shape process improvements involving AI, automation, analytics, workflow redesign, simplification, or operational efficiencies. Strong analytical fluency and the ability to translate complex or ambiguous challenges into structured recommendations and executable plans. Strong executive presence, credibility, communication, and stakeholder-management skills. Demonstrated ability to collaborate and influence senior partners without direct authority. Proven people-leadership experience, including setting direction, coaching talent, and building team capability. Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint. Bachelor s degree or equivalent professional experience. Preferred Qualifications: Experience within merchant operations, onboarding, account maintenance, servicing, pricing, payments, or a related function. Knowledge of merchant account structures, hierarchy processes, data enrichment, or Know Your Customer processes. Experience delivering operational transformation, AI, automation, workflow, analytics, or technology-enabled process improvements. Experience supporting operational-risk events, corrective-action plans, remediation, or control-enhancement programs. Familiarity with analytical and visualization tools such as SQL, Python, Tableau, Power BI, or comparable platforms. Experience working across multiple markets or global teams. Critical Factors to Success: Apply strong program governance and execution discipline across transformation and remediation initiatives. Convert AI, automation, analytics, and process-improvement opportunities into scalable and sustainable operational capabilities. Deliver measurable improvements in efficiency, data quality, controls, and operational outcomes. Bring structure, transparency, and accountability to complex cross-functional programs. Build trusted partnerships and influence decisions without direct authority. Leadership Behaviors: The successful candidate should consistently demonstrate the American Express Leadership Behaviours by: Defining What Winning Looks Like: Establishing clear priorities, outcomes, delivery plans, and success measures. Putting Enterprise Thinking First: Balancing business value, merchant and customer outcomes, colleague impact, operational feasibility, and the control environment. Making Collaboration Essential: Building trusted partnerships while maintaining clarity on ownership, accountability, and decision rights. Seeking and Providing Coaching and Feedback: Strengthening team capability through regular, candid, and actionable development conversations. Communicating Frequently, Candidly, and Clearly: Providing transparent information on progress, risks, issues, dependencies, benefits, and required actions. Making Decisions Quickly and Effectively: Evaluating alternatives and balancing speed, business value, data, implementation effort, risk, and sustainable outcomes. Demonstrating Courageous and Authentic Leadership: Raising concerns proactively, challenging assumptions, and creating an environment where colleagues can speak up. Leading with a Digital and Improvement Mindset: Challenging how work is performed and identifying scalable opportunities to simplify, automate, and improve operational outcomes. Key Responsibilities Drive Merchant Hierarchy process transformation Develop and execute a prioritized roadmap to simplify, standardize, automate, and modernize Merchant Hierarchy review processes in partnership with the teams responsible for governance and operational delivery. Translate operational pain points into structured improvement opportunities that reduce manual effort, improve turnaround times and data quality, strengthen controls, and create scalable capabilities. Coordinate cross-functional partners, dependencies, decisions, operating-model changes, and adoption activities required to deliver sustainable enterprise-wide process uplift. Advance AI, automation, and analytics Identify and prioritize opportunities to use AI, automation, analytics, workflow tools, external data, and emerging technologies to improve operational processes and outcomes. Partner with Product, Technology, Analytics, and Operations teams to evaluate solutions and progress them from problem definition through implementation, adoption, and benefits measurement. Ensure new capabilities address clear business needs and are supported by appropriate data, controls, ownership, governance, and performance monitoring. Lead remediation and strategic program execution Lead or provide PMO support for complex remediation, operational-risk, control-enhancement, and strategic-change initiatives across functions and markets. Establish effective program governance, including clear scope, milestones, ownership, decision rights, dependencies, risks, escalation paths, and success measures. Drive change management, operational readiness, and executive reporting while maintaining accountability through implementation, stabilization, and benefits realization. Strengthen stakeholder partnerships and team effectiveness Serve as a trusted stakeholder anchor across business, Operations, Servicing, Pricing, Client Management, Product, Technology, Analytics, Risk, Compliance, Policy, and Control Management. Demonstrate executive presence and influence senior leaders and cross-functional partners without direct authority through structured thinking, sound judgement, constructive challenge, and clear communication. Lead and develop a high-performing team with strong capabilities across program governance, remediation, operational transformation, analytics, automation, and stakeholder management.

About TETR Five years ago, we started Masters Union; our vision: to redefine the landscape of business education. We posed a simple question: If aspiring doctors learn from seasoned physicians and budding lawyers learn from legal experts, why shouldn't future business leaders learn directly from industry experts? 
 After all, can a lecture on Accounting 101 truly compare to the hands-on experience of analyzing real PnL statements?

Our academic council includes CXOs, MDs, Eminent Public Leaders, and even Members of Parliament. From launching eCommerce ventures in Dubai to tackling tech startups in Silicon Valley, our students traverse the globe, building businesses and making a tangible impact. title: It Infrastructure Manager
description:
Work From Office Only 
 Job Description: IT Infrastructure Manager Job Title: IT Infrastructure Manager 
 Department: Information Technology 
 Reports To: Head of IT / CIO / CTO 
 Experience: 58 years in IT infrastructure and operations, including 3–5 years in a team leadership or managerial role 
 Location: As per business requirement 1. Job Purpose The IT Infrastructure Manager is responsible for managing and maintaining the organization's IT infrastructure, including servers, networks, email systems, endpoint security, firewall, patch management, IT operations, and MIS reporting. The role ensures reliable, secure, and efficient IT services while minimizing cloud administration and compliance-related activities. 2. Key Responsibilities A. IT Infrastructure Management Manage physical and virtual servers, storage systems, network infrastructure, and related IT services. Ensure infrastructure availability, reliability, performance, and business continuity. Plan and execute infrastructure upgrades, system configurations, technology refreshes, and preventive maintenance. Monitor infrastructure performance and resolve hardware, software, and connectivity issues. Maintain updated infrastructure documentation, asset inventories, and configuration records. B. Network and Connectivity Management Manage LAN, WAN, Wi-Fi, VPN, internet connectivity, switches, routers, and network devices. Ensure secure and reliable connectivity across offices, branches, and remote users. Monitor network availability, bandwidth utilization, and performance. Coordinate with internet service providers, telecom vendors, and third-party service providers. Troubleshoot network outagdes and implement corrective actions to prevent recurring issues. C. Server and Email Management Administer Windows/Linux servers, virtualization platforms, Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, and Group Policy. Manage corporate email services and user accounts through Google Workspace. Administer email creation, modification, deactivation, distribution groups, aliases, and access permissions. Manage email security settings, spam filtering, email routing, and account security policies. Troubleshoot email delivery, synchronization, login, and mailbox-related issues. Manage Google Workspace user licenses and coordinate renewals as required. D. Firewall Management – Palo Alto Administer and maintain Palo Alto firewalls, including security policies, NAT rules, and access controls. Monitor firewall logs, traffic patterns, security events, and connectivity issues. Configure and maintain VPN connectivity and approved network access rules. Review firewall policies periodically and remove obsolete or unauthorized rules. Coordinate firmware updates, configuration backups, and troubleshooting with vendors where required. Maintain firewall configuration documentation and support security incident investigations. E. Antivirus and Endpoint Security – Sophos Manage Sophos antivirus and endpoint protection across servers and end-user devices. Monitor endpoint security status, malware alerts, detection events, and protection coverage. Ensure antivirus definitions, security agents, and protection policies remain updated. Investigate malware detections and coordinate containment, remediation, and recovery. Track devices with inactive agents or unresolved security alerts and ensure corrective action. Prepare periodic endpoint security status reports. F. Patch Management – ManageEngine Manage operating system and approved third-party application patching using ManageEngine patch management solutions. Plan patch deployment schedules, testing, approvals, and phased rollouts. Monitor patch compliance across servers, desktops, and laptops. Identify failed, pending, and missing patches and ensure timely remediation. Coordinate maintenance windows and communicate planned downtime to stakeholders. Maintain patch deployment records and generate patch compliance reports. G. IT Operations and Service Management Lead the IT infrastructure support team and ensure timely resolution of incidents and service requests. Define and monitor SLAs, KPIs, escalation procedures, and service delivery standards. Manage incident, problem, and change management processes using appropriate IT service management practices. Conduct root cause analysis for recurring infrastructure issues. Manage IT assets, software licenses, vendor contracts, and infrastructure documentation. Coordinate with business teams to minimize IT disruptions and improve service quality. H. Monthly MIS Reporting Prepare and publish monthly IT infrastructure MIS reports for management review. Report infrastructure uptime, network availability, server health, and major incidents. Prepare monthly patch management and compliance reports using ManageEngine. Report Sophos antivirus coverage, threat detections, unresolved alerts, and endpoint protection status. Prepare Palo Alto firewall incident summaries, VPN availability, and major security event reports. Report Google Workspace user accounts, license utilization, and email-related incidents. Track IT helpdesk tickets, SLA performance, incident trends, and pending issues. Maintain IT asset inventory, hardware allocation, warranty status, and software license records. Report vendor performance, recurring issues, infrastructure risks, and corrective action plans. Highlight key issues, monthly trends, improvement initiatives, and management action items. I. Information Security and Basic Compliance Maintenance Implement approved IT security policies, access controls, and endpoint protection measures. Ensure timely system updates, security patches, antivirus updates, and access reviews. Maintain basic IT audit evidence, infrastructure records, and security-related documentation. Coordinate with the designated information security or compliance team for audits and compliance requirements. Support vulnerability remediation and security incident response. Focus on practical infrastructure security and documentation rather than owning extensive cloud governance or compliance programs. J. Team and Vendor Management Supervise and guide infrastructure engineers, system administrators, network engineers, and IT support personnel. Allocate responsibilities, monitor team performance, and ensure timely issue resolution. Coordinate with hardware suppliers, software vendors, ISPs, and managed service providers. Manage vendor escalations, renewals, support contracts, and service delivery. Support infrastructure procurement, budgeting, and cost optimization. 3. Required Skills and Qualifications Education Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field. Relevant IT certifications are an advantage. Technical Skills Windows Server administration, Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, and Group Policy. Networking fundamentals, TCP/IP, routing, switching, VLANs, VPNs, and Wi-Fi. Palo Alto firewall administration and policy management. Sophos antivirus and endpoint protection management. ManageEngine patch management and patch compliance reporting. Google Workspace administration, email management, and user lifecycle management. VMware or Hyper-V virtualization. IT monitoring, endpoint management, troubleshooting, and infrastructure documentation. Basic backup and recovery knowledge. Cloud administration: Basic exposure only; not a primary responsibility. Compliance and audit documentation: Basic maintenance and coordination only. Managerial Skills Team leadership and IT operations management. Vendor coordination and stakeholder communication. Incident management, problem-solving, and escalation handling. Monthly MIS preparation, data analysis, and management reporting. IT asset management, license tracking, and cost control. Planning, prioritization, and documentation. 4. Experience Requirements 5–8 years of experience in IT infrastructure and operations. 3–5 years of experience in infrastructure team leadership, administration, or managerial responsibilities. Hands-on experience with enterprise networks, servers, end-user computing, and IT support operations. Practical experience in Google Workspace, Palo Alto firewalls, Sophos endpoint security, and ManageEngine patch management is preferred. Experience preparing monthly IT MIS reports and monitoring service delivery KPIs. Experience coordinating vendors, infrastructure upgrades, and security remediation activities. 5. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Infrastructure, server, and network availability. IT incident resolution time and SLA compliance. Reduction in recurring infrastructure issues. ManageEngine patch deployment success and patch compliance. Sophos endpoint protection coverage and unresolved threat alerts. Palo Alto firewall availability and timely resolution of network security issues. Google Workspace email service availability and email incident resolution. Timely submission and accuracy of monthly MIS reports. IT asset inventory accuracy and license tracking. Infrastructure project delivery within approved timelines and budgets. Internal user satisfaction and IT service quality. 6. Key Stakeholders CIO / CTO / Head of IT IT Infrastructure and Support Teams Information Security and Compliance Teams Application and Business Teams Finance and Procurement External Vendors and Managed Service Providers End Users and Business Unit Heads 7. Expected Outcomes The IT Infrastructure Manager will ensure stable, secure, and efficient IT infrastructure operations, reliable corporate email services, effective firewall and endpoint protection, timely patch deployment, and accurate monthly MIS reporting. The role will prioritize hands-on infrastructure management and operational security, with limited responsibility for cloud administration and compliance program ownership.

title: Brand Strategy & Creative Lead-Leading Consulting Company
description:
Job Overview 
 The Brand Strategy & Creative Lead will drive brand positioning, creative direction, content strategy, scripting, and copywriting across multiple brands and digital platforms. 
 This is a hands-on, strategic and execution-oriented role for someone who can translate business objectives into compelling creative ideas, engaging content, and measurable marketing outcomes. 
 The ideal candidate will combine strategic thinking with excellent writing skills, strong visual sensibility, and the ability to guide designers, video editors, and other creative resources. The role requires balancing B2B thought leadership and leadership branding with consumer-focused content designed to drive engagement and conversions. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 1. Brand & Creative Strategy Develop and evolve brand identity and content strategy across Instagram, LinkedIn, and YouTube Shorts. Translate brand positioning into content pillars, recurring formats, creative concepts, and consistent brand voice guidelines. Develop campaign ideas for both lean, high-velocity executions and larger, production-led campaigns. Identify opportunities for creator partnerships, brand collaborations, and community engagement. 
 2. Content Strategy & Planning Develop weekly content calendars aligned with brand objectives and marketing performance goals. Plan Reels, carousels, static posts, LinkedIn content, and other relevant digital formats. Maintain a consistent and cohesive visual identity across social media profiles. Track industry trends, competitor activity, and emerging content formats to identify relevant opportunities. Develop founder-led and leadership-focused content, including thought-leadership posts and recurring video series. 
 3. Video Scripting & Storytelling Write engaging scripts for Reels, YouTube Shorts, talking-head videos, advertisements, and brand films. Create strong opening hooks and alternative script variations for testing and optimisation. Structure content to improve audience retention, engagement, and sharing. Develop thought-provoking scripts for leadership and business-focused content. Prepare production-ready scripts with dialogue, on-screen text, B-roll suggestions, visual cues, shot lists, and captions. Create briefs for user-generated content (UGC) and creators, and guide on-camera presenters on delivery, pacing, and tone. 
 4. Copywriting & Brand Communication Write social media captions, carousel narratives, calls to action, story copy, and on-screen text. Develop performance advertising copy, including headlines, primary text, and descriptions, with multiple variations for testing. Write LinkedIn posts and thought-leadership articles for founders and senior leadership. Develop campaign messaging, taglines, website copy, landing-page content, and launch communication. Create and maintain brand voice guidelines to ensure consistency across platforms and contributors. 
 5. Creative Execution & Team Management Brief graphic designers with clear creative direction, audience insights, messaging priorities, and visual references. Guide video editors on storytelling, pacing, structure, and editing style. Review creative outputs and provide specific, actionable feedback. Manage the creative process from briefing to final publication, ensuring timelines and quality standards are met. Take ownership of the final approval process for creative deliverables. 
 6. Performance Marketing & Content Optimisation Collaborate with the performance marketing team to define creative requirements based on brand objectives, audience segments, and funnel stages. Analyse creative performance metrics, including hook rate, audience retention, click-through rate (CTR), cost per acquisition (CPA), and return on ad spend (ROAS). Use performance insights to improve creative concepts, messaging, hooks, and formats. Apply learnings from organic content to paid campaigns and vice versa. 
 7. On-Ground Content & Quality Control Plan and direct content shoots at events, client locations, and product or brand launches. Develop timely, relevant content around emerging trends and cultural moments. Review design, video, and copy for quality, clarity, consistency, and brand alignment. Maintain high creative standards while working in a fast-paced, multi-brand environment. 
 Candidate Profile 
 Essential Requirements Minimum 3 years of experience in brand strategy, content strategy, creative strategy, or a related field. Strong hands-on writing and copywriting skills, supported by a relevant portfolio. Experience creating content for Instagram-first consumer brands. Ability to develop credible B2B communication and leadership-focused content for LinkedIn. Strong understanding of storytelling, visual communication, social media trends, and creative formats. Ability to brief and guide designers, video editors, and creative teams effectively. Comfortable managing multiple brands, deadlines, and iterative creative workflows. 
 Preferred Qualifications Experience working with an advertising agency, creative agency, or consultancy. Exposure to hospitality, FMCG, dairy, or food & beverage brands. Experience scripting and directing founder-led content or talking-head video series. Bilingual writing ability in English and Hindi. Working knowledge of Meta Ads Manager, CapCut, Canva, and Figma. 
 Key Deliverables Weekly content calendars and creative plans. Video scripts with hooks, shot lists, and on-screen text. Social media copy and performance advertising variations. Creative briefs and approved content assets. Leadership-focused LinkedIn content. Monthly creative performance reviews and optimisation recommendations. Campaign concepts, collaboration proposals, and updated brand guidelines.

Key Skills: Social media,Brand communication,Company,Content creation,Creative,Performance Marketing,Communication skills,Digital

WHAT YOULL BRING Essential 3+ years of relevant experience in cable systems engineering/design, preferably within substations, transmission or renewable energy projects. Experience interfacing cable systems with primary substation design. Proficiency in AutoCAD and ability to produce/review technical drawings. Experience preparing technical reports, calculations and design documentation. Ability to coordinate effectively with multiple engineering disciplines, suppliers, clients and DNOs. Are confident communicating technical information to clients, DNOs, suppliers and project teams. Are proactive in identifying technical risks and developing practical engineering solutions. Team size: 20+ engineers and technicians Experience: 1215 years overall; minimum 5 years hands-on in a tool room workshop Location: MMTC PAMP Plant, Sohna Nuh, Haryana.

Plan workload, shift allocation and tooling priorities against production and minting schedules. Set tool room standards, SOPs and preventive-maintenance schedules for dies and tooling. Guide die and tooling design and validate dimensions, tolerances and surface finish before release. Drive improvements in die life, quality, cycle time and cost per die. Programming and design oversight Oversee CAD/CAM design and programming for VMC, wire cut, EDM, CNC lathe and laser operations. Review and approve programs, toolpaths and design files created in NX, Elcam, E Cam V1, Rhino and AutoCAD. Review artwork and graphic files prepared in Photoshop and Illustrator for engraving and laser processes. Printing and laser processes Support tooling and process needs for inkjet, screen and laser printing or marking, where applicable to the minting operation. Coordinate with production, quality and R&D on new designs, process trials and tooling changes. People, safety and cost Hire, train, mentor and appraise engineers and technicians; build succession and multi-skilling. Enforce workshop safety, 5S and statutory compliance. Prepare and manage the tool room budget, machine utilisation, consumables and vendor and outsourcing spend. 
 Qualifications and Skills Required B.Tech or Diploma in Mechanical Engineering or Printing Technology 10-15 years of total experience Minimum 5 years of hands-on experience in a tool room workshop Robust core knowledge of the die-making process, with hands-on experience in the first 35 years of career Minimum 10 years leading an industrial tool room with a team of 20+ engineers

 This profile will be responsible for overseeing and managing all inbound logistics operations, including import management. This role involves coordinating with supplier, Forwarders, Custom House Management, Custom authorities & warehousing team. Responsible for accurate inventory management. The Inbound Manager will work closely with suppliers, transportation providers, and internal teams to optimize inbound processes and maintain high standards of service. 
 Key Responsibilities: 
 Inbound Operations Management: Oversee the entire inbound logistics process, including the receipt, inspection, and storage of goods. Ensure compliance with safety and quality standards during the inbound process. Manage the scheduling of incoming shipments and coordinate with suppliers to ensure timely deliveries. Import Management: Manage all aspects of import logistics, including compliance with customs regulations and documentation requirements. Coordinate with customs brokers and freight forwarders to ensure smooth import processes and timely clearance of goods. Stay updated on import regulations, tariffs, and trade agreements that may impact operations. Inventory Control: Monitor inventory levels and ensure accuracy in inventory records. Implement and maintain effective inventory management systems to track inbound shipments. Conduct regular audits of inventory to identify discrepancies and resolve issues. Process Improvement: Identify opportunities for process improvements and implement best practices to enhance the efficiency of inbound logistics. Collaborate with other departments (e.g., procurement, production, and distribution) to streamline operations. Supplier and Vendor Management: Build and maintain strong relationships with suppliers and transportation providers to ensure reliable and efficient inbound logistics. Resolve any issues or discrepancies related to shipments and deliveries. Reporting and Analysis: Prepare regular reports on inbound logistics performance, inventory levels, and other key metrics. Analyze data to identify trends and areas for improvement. 
 Qualifications: Bachelors degree in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, or a related field. Proven experience in logistics, supply chain management, or a similar role, with a focus on inbound operations and import management. Strong understanding of customs regulations and import processes. Strong leadership and team management skills. Excellent organizational and problem-solving abilities. Proficient in inventory management software and Microsoft Office Suite. Strong communication and interpersonal skills. Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and manage multiple tasks effectively. title: Warehouse Executive
description:
Kawasaki Robotics is looking for a detail-oriented and proactive Warehouse Executive to manage day-to-day warehouse and inventory operations. The ideal candidate should have a basic understanding of warehouse processes, hands-on experience with ERP/WMS systems, and strong MS Excel skills. The candidate will be responsible for material receipt, storage, inventory control, stock reconciliation, picking, packing, dispatch, and warehouse documentation while maintaining safety and 5S standards. 
 Key Responsibilities Receive incoming materials and verify quantities against purchase orders, invoices, and delivery documents. Inspect, identify, label, and store materials in designated locations while following FIFO/FEFO practices. Perform picking, packing, and dispatch of materials accurately within specified timelines. Maintain inventory records and update material receipts, issues, transfers, and dispatches in ERP/WMS or MS Excel. Conduct cycle counts and physical stock verification, investigate discrepancies, and support stock reconciliation. Prepare and maintain Goods Receipt Notes (GRN), stock transfer notes, material issue and return records, and dispatch documentation. Coordinate with procurement, production, quality, and logistics teams to ensure smooth material movement. Maintain proper material arrangement, warehouse cleanliness, and 5S standards. Follow warehouse safety procedures and ensure the safe handling of materials, tools, and equipment. Monitor and report shortages, damaged materials, excess stock, and non-moving inventory to the supervisor. Prepare basic inventory reports and support warehouse process improvements. 
 Desired Candidate Profile Graduate in any discipline. 6-12 months of experience in warehouse, stores, logistics, or inventory operations. Good spoken English and basic written communication skills. Hands-on knowledge of ERP/WMS systems for material receipt, issue, transfer, and inventory updates. Proficiency in Advanced MS Excel, including PivotTables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, filters, and inventory reporting. Understanding of inventory control, cycle counting, stock reconciliation, and FIFO/FEFO practices. Good documentation, record-keeping, and data-entry skills. Detail-oriented, disciplined, organized, and capable of coordinating with internal teams. Quick learner with a positive attitude and willingness to learn new systems and processes. Ability to handle warehouse activities while adhering to safety requirements. Must be based in or willing to work in Gurgaon. 
 Employment Details Salary: 22,000-27,000 per month Job Location: Gurgaon, Haryana Qualification: Graduate Experience Required: 6-12 months 
 Interested candidates with relevant warehouse operations experience, good Excel skills, and knowledge of ERP/WMS systems are encouraged to apply.

Strong attention to detail and ownership of assigned responsibilities.

title: Enterprise Agentic AI Architect
description:
Job Summary 
 Coursera s AI adoption has moved fast - engineering teams code AI-first, dozens of internal tools have shipped, and functions across the business are building their own AI agents and automations. The next phase requires something different: a shared technical foundation that lets many teams build safely and cost-effectively at scale, instead of each team solving governance, security, and cost from scratch. 
 
 Responsibilities 
 Context Semantic Architecture - Design how AI agents access and understand Coursera s internal data and knowledge, so agents retrieve the right information rather than guessing or over-fetching. Establish reusable patterns for RAG, semantic search, structured data access, and enterprise context, partnering with the Data team on existing data models and pipelines. Agentic Architecture Harness Engineering - Design reusable patterns for agent orchestration, tool use, multi-step workflows, state management, and human-in-the-loop decisions. Build the engineering harness around agents, including testing, evaluation, guardrails, retries, observability, and failure recovery, so agentic solutions are reliable and production-ready. Governance Architecture - Build technical guardrails that enforce-not just document-who can build what, what data and systems an agent can access, and what gets logged for audit and review. Establish standards for agent ownership, lifecycle management, and production readiness. Security Architecture - Design defenses specific to agentic AI, including agent identity and access control, least-privilege permissions, prompt injection, data leakage, secure credentials, and safe tool execution. Coordinate with Security to extend existing enterprise security standards. Self-Serve AI Development ( Vibe Coding ) with CI/CD Automation - Extend and mature Coursera s self-serve deployment path so AI-assisted, conversational development ships through automated testing, security checks, and evaluation gates-safe by default, not safe by manual gatekeeping. LLM Cost Performance Optimization - Design caching, model routing (matching task complexity to the right-sized model), token and context optimization, and usage monitoring so AI adoption can scale without costs growing linearly. Establish cost, latency, quality, and usage metrics. Agent Operating Model Adoption - Define agent ownership, lifecycle management, production-readiness standards, adoption metrics, and reusable patterns so business teams can scale AI capabilities consistently across functions. Measure success through usage, workflow outcomes, productivity, quality, and business value. Architecture Strategy Execution - Turn ambiguous business problems into scalable technical direction, practical roadmaps, architecture decisions, and production delivery. Enterprise Systems Integration Architecture - Design AI solutions that understand dependencies across enterprise systems, business processes, integrations, and downstream impacts. Establish reusable patterns for APIs, enterprise tools, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) or comparable integration standards where appropriate. Production Readiness Operational Excellence - Establish standards for reliability, observability, incident response, security, operational ownership, and continuous improvement across AI platforms and solutions. 
 
 How This Role Works With Others 
 This role sits at the intersection of four groups and requires strong cross-functional partnership-it does not operate in isolation. Engineering Leadership: Partner directly with Engineering leadership to align architecture decisions and share resources and infrastructure where possible, avoiding duplicate build efforts across the company. IT: IT owns broader company-wide tooling and platform decisions (procurement, provisioning, cost governance, enterprise policy). Coordinate closely with IT so agentic architecture decisions align with company-wide technical direction rather than creating a parallel, ungoverned stack. Data Team: The Data team owns Coursera s underlying data strategy. Partner with them to ensure context and semantic architecture aligns with existing data models, pipelines, and ownership rather than building a parallel, disconnected data layer for AI. Security Team: Design security architecture specific to agentic AI-including access control, prompt injection defense, and credential handling-in coordination with the Security team, which owns broader security standards and policy. Business Pods: Enable the 3-4 person pods (Business Product Owner, Process Expert, IT Product Owner, AI Engineer) to redesign workflows, build AI-native solutions, and drive measurable business outcomes using reusable architecture. Change Management Enablement: Help teams adopt AI-enabled workflows through enablement, feedback loops, process redesign, and continuous improvement. 
 
 People Leadership 
 Build, coach, and develop the architecture and engineering capability required to scale the platform. This includes hiring, delegation, technical leadership development, performance management, and creating clear ownership across teams. Build strong technical leaders who can independently own architecture, delivery, stakeholder alignment, and operational outcomes. 
 
 AI Center of Excellence / VP, AI and Operations 
 Report directly to the VP, AI and Operations, providing regular updates on architecture progress, risks, business impact, and resourcing needs. 
 
 What We're Looking For 
 
 Must-Have 
 12+ years of experience with clear progression from engineer to senior/staff engineer to architect leader, including ownership of platforms or infrastructure used by multiple teams-not just individual feature delivery. Hands-on experience with agentic AI frameworks and orchestration (e.g., LangGraph or comparable) and familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP) or similar standards for connecting AI systems to enterprise data and tools. Experience designing agent harnesses, evaluation frameworks, guardrails, testing, observability, and failure recovery for production AI systems. Practical experience with enterprise context architecture, RAG, semantic search, or structured data access. Practical experience with LLM cost and performance engineering-prompt caching, model routing, token economics-with quantifiable results. AI security fundamentals, including access control, data isolation, prompt injection defense, and secure tool execution. CI/CD, cloud infrastructure, APIs, and production operations experience. title: AI Video Editor | Reels, YouTube and Motion Graphics
description:
Role & responsibilities You will be our video editor for client brands and our own channels. That covers short-form video (Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, social media ads) and long-form video (YouTube videos, podcasts, interviews, brand films). You take raw footage and a brief and turn them into something people watch to the end, and you own the edit from the first cut to the final export. You need to know Premiere Pro and After Effects well, but we hire for judgment. We expect you to know why a video loses viewers at the 4-second mark, which shot should open it, and what to cut, and to be able to explain those calls when someone pushes back. 
 What you will do: Edit Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts and social media ads with a strong hook, tight pacing, and subtitles that work with the sound off. Edit long-form YouTube videos, podcasts, interviews and brand films so the structure holds from the first minute to the last. Use visual storytelling to build the story from raw footage: pick the moments, shape the arc, and cut for clarity and emotion. Create motion graphics, text animation, titles and lower thirds in Adobe After Effects. Use AI video generation (text-to-video and image-to-video) to create B-roll, shots and motion elements, and blend them with live footage so they look intentional. Handle color correction and color grading, sound design, audio editing, music selection and voiceover cleanup. Turn one shoot into multiple formats and aspect ratios (16:9, 9:16, 1:1) for Instagram, YouTube, Facebook and LinkedIn. Take feedback from the content, design and client teams, and turn revisions around quickly without losing the idea of the edit. 

 What we need: 1-2 years of professional video editing experience at a digital marketing agency, production house or in-house team, or as a freelancer. Strong command of Adobe Premiere Pro and Adobe After Effects. You should be fast in both. A clear sense of storytelling: pacing, structure, rhythm, and how retention works on Reels and Shorts. A portfolio or showreel with both short-form and long-form work. We will judge you on this more than on your CV. Hands-on experience with AI video tools such as Runway, Kling, Google Veo, Sora, Pika, Luma, Adobe Firefly or HeyGen, and AI tools for captions, voice (ElevenLabs) and upscaling. Good prompting is part of the job. If you built an AI workflow that saves you hours, tell us about it. A good eye for typography, colour and composition. The ability to run several projects at once and meet deadlines without the quality slipping. 
 Nice to have Photoshop or Illustrator for preparing assets. Experience reading YouTube retention graphs and watch-time data and re-editing based on them. Experience editing performance ads for Meta (Instagram, Facebook) or YouTube. Basic camera and shooting knowledge. 

 How to apply 
Send your CV and a portfolio or showreel link with both short-form and long-form work. Add three to five lines on one video you edited: what the raw footage looked like, what story you chose to tell, and the one editing decision that made it work. Applications without a portfolio and that answer will not be read.

description:
OVERALL RESPONSIBILITY 
 Reporting to the Senior Manager, International HR, this role will work closely with the international HR team, local HR teams across the globe, and our Protiviti HR Centers of Excellence. You will be responsible for coordinating key HR compliance activities. You will have the opportunity to support our key global HR processes and our Global HR Leaders as we deliver against our HR strategy. You will also provide as needed, administrative support to our teams across the Globe. 
 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 
 The following statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. This is not 
 intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required of personnel. 
 HR Compliance

 Organization Controls 2 (SOC2)

 protiviti.com 
 Policies & Procedures

 3. Support any ad hoc or global employee engagement initiatives that enhances employee experience across international offices 
 HR Communications 
 1. Establishment and on-going management of an annual HR communication schedule for key HR processes, ensuring consistency of core messages across the international region 
 2. Provide administrative support to the International HR team as needed 
 Inclusion 
 1. Partnering with the global Inclusion PMO team and local HR teams to organize and drive participation in global and international Inclusion related initiatives and events 
 2. Responsible for coordinating inclusion accolades questionnaires across participating offices across APAC and Europe 
 3. Coordinate and maintain records of Inclusion leaders and Employee Network Groups by office, and provide support to local teams on inclusion related matters

title: Director International Operations (Logistics)
description:
Job Overview We are seeking a seasoned, high-caliber logistics leader for the role of Director – Cross-Border Operations. Based out of our Gurgaon headquarters, you will lead end-to-end international logistics operations for Delhivery, overseeing cross-border import and export shipments across key global trade lanes. This is a strategic and execution-intensive role. You will spearhead the expansion of our international freight network by launching new country corridors and deferred air economy products, while driving revenue growth through strategic partnerships. This position owns P&L, SLA compliance, and operational efficiency for both air and ocean freight verticals. Key Responsibilities 1. End-to-End International Logistics Operations Lead end-to-end international logistics operations, managing and optimizing cross-border import and export shipments across global trade lanes. Supervise daily workflows for inbound and outbound cargo, ensuring smooth execution across origin handling, international linehaul, customs clearance, and last-mile delivery. Implement robust monitoring systems to track shipments, proactively resolve operational exceptions, and ensure high on-time delivery rates. Should be able to create and manage dashboards  Hold reviews internally with cross functional teams and externally with partners in destination country Should be able to design using BI tools and define metrics internally and for partners 2. Network Expansion & Product Development Spearhead the physical and operational expansion of Delhivery's international freight network by identifying and launching new country corridors. Design, launch, and scale deferred air economy products to offer competitive, cost-effective cross-border shipping options to e-commerce, SME, and enterprise clients. Establish standard operating procedures (SOPs) and operational readiness criteria for all newly launched corridors and lanes. 3. Strategic Partnerships & Carrier Management Identify, negotiate with, and onboard key global partners, including freight forwarders, customs house agents (CHAs), customs brokers, and commercial airlines/ocean carriers. Build and maintain strong strategic alliances to secure capacity commitments, preferential rate structures, and reliable transit times during peak and non-peak seasons. Manage partner performance SLAs, conducting regular reviews to ensure compliance with Delhivery's high operational standards. 4. P&L & SLA Compliance Management Take complete financial ownership of the Air and Ocean freight verticals, managing P&L, cost optimization, and overall unit economics (e.g., cost-per-kilogram and route margins). Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) such as Transit Turnaround Time (TAT), On-Time Delivery (OTD), Customs Clearance timelines, and first-contact dispute resolution. Control and minimize operational exceptions such as terminal storage costs, demurrage, detention fees, and flight offloads. 5. Cross-Functional Collaboration & Tech Enablement Collaborate closely with internal stakeholders including Sales, Business Development, Technology, and Legal/Compliance to support business growth and process standardization. Partner with Product and Engineering teams to build scalable, automated, and technology-driven processes for tracking, billing, and customs documentation. Ensure 100% adherence to international trade laws, customs regulations, aviation security standards, and safety compliances. Required Skills & Qualifications Experience & Education Education: Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, International Business, Engineering, or a related field. An MBA or Post-Graduate degree is highly preferred. Experience: 8+ years of progressive experience in international logistics, freight forwarding, or cross-border e-commerce shipping. Leadership: Minimum of 3+ years in a senior supervisory or managerial role directly overseeing air/ocean freight operations, partner management, or international linehaul. Core Competencies Domain Expertise: Deep working knowledge of air/ocean freight operations, global trade lanes, Incoterms 2020, customs clearance regulations, and HAWB/MAWB rules (aligned with our Global Air Freight Operations). Commercial & Financial Acumen: Strong experience managing P&L, negotiating complex commercial contracts, and optimizing unit economics. Analytical Rigor: Advanced proficiency in MS Excel and Google Sheets for tracking operations, data analysis, and building performance dashboards. Stakeholder & Vendor Management: Exceptional negotiation and relationship-building skills to manage high-level partnerships across multiple geographies. Problem-Solving: Strong critical-thinking and crisis-management abilities to handle transit disruptions, customs bottlenecks, and capacity constraints in a high-pressure environmen

title: AM-Taxation
description:
Job purpose: To support and independently manage day-to-day Direct Taxation and TDS compliances, including timely filing of TDS returns, reconciliation of books with statutory returns, preparation and response to Income Tax notices, tax data analysis, and coordination with internal teams and consultants. The role will also require a working understanding of GST and other indirect tax matters to support the overall Taxation function. 
 Primary responsibilities: 1. TDS Compliance & Return Filing • Ensure timely preparation and filing of quarterly TDS/TCS returns within statutory due dates. • Review TDS applicability and rates on various payments such as rent, professional fees, contractor payments, commission, interest and other business expenses. • Reconcile TDS deducted in books with TDS returns before filing. • Coordinate for correction/revised TDS returns wherever required. Monitor TDS challans, deductions, balances and statutory payment status. • Support issuance and reconciliation of Form 16/16A and other TDS certificates. 
 2. Books vs. Return Reconciliation Perform regular reconciliation between books of accounts and TDS returns. • Identify differences in TDS deduction, vendor PAN, amount, section, rate and challan details. • Reconcile TDS/TCS balances with Form 26AS/AIS/TIS, wherever applicable. Coordinate with Accounts, Payroll, Procurement and other departments for resolution of reconciliation differences. • Maintain proper reconciliation workings and supporting documents for audit and assessment purposes. 
 3. Income Tax Notices & Assessments • Monitor and maintain records of Income Tax notices, communications and proceedings. • Prepare data, reconciliations and supporting documents required for responding to Income Tax notices. • Coordinate with tax consultants and internal stakeholders for preparation and submission of replies. Assist in matters relating to TDS defaults, demands, assessments and other Income Tax proceedings. Track notice-wise status, due dates, submissions and closure of outstanding matters. Maintain a proper Income Tax Notice & Litigation Tracker. 
 4. Direct Tax Compliance & Taxation Support Assist in preparation of advance tax, self-assessment tax and tax computation workings. Support preparation of tax audit and income-tax-related schedules and information. Assist in computation and reconciliation of current tax and other direct tax-related balances. • Support statutory, internal and tax audits by providing required information and documents. • Keep track of amendments and notifications under the Income-tax Act, Rules and applicable TDS provisions. 
 5. GST / Indirect Tax Knowledge Possess working knowledge of GST provisions, GST returns and basic ITC concepts. Understand the interaction between GST and direct tax/TDS transactions wherever applicable. • Assist the Taxation Team in reconciliation and analysis of GST-related data when required. • Coordinate with the GST team for common tax data, vendor details and reconciliation requirements. Develop working knowledge of GST notices, compliance requirements and relevant provisions. 
 Required Skills: • Good knowledge of TDS/TCS provisions and Income-tax Act. • Practical experience in TDS return preparation and filing. • Strong reconciliation skills Books vs. TDS Returns vs. 26AS/AIS/TIS. • Experience in handling/preparing data for Income Tax notices and assessments. • Working knowledge of GST and indirect taxation. • Good knowledge of MS Excel, including Pivot Tables, XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, SUMIFS and reconciliation techniques. • Good analytical and problem-solving skills. • Ability to coordinate with internal departments and external consultants

Key Skills: TDS,Direct Tax,Tax Compliance,Taxation,Indirect Taxation,Tax Audit,Tax Returns,ITR

title: Software Development Engineer in Test II
description:
Job Description:

GreyOrange is seeking a highly motivated Software Development Engineer in Test II to join our dynamic team. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, maintaining, and implementing automated test frameworks to ensure the quality and reliability of our software products. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to understand project requirements and create comprehensive testing strategies that encompass functional, integration, and performance testing.

Key Responsibilities:
- Design and develop automated test scripts and frameworks using industry-standard tools and technologies.
- Collaborate with developers and product managers to define testing criteria and ensure thorough testing coverage.
- Identify, analyze, and document defects in software applications, working with the development team to resolve issues quickly and efficiently.
- Participate in code reviews and provide feedback on software design and implementation.
- Monitor and report on testing progress, results, and metrics to ensure timely releases.
- Contribute to process improvements and best practices in the QA and testing lifecycle.
- Stay updated on the latest testing tools, trends, and technologies to continually enhance testing processes.

Skills Required:
- Strong programming skills in languages such as Java, Python, or C#.
- Experience in test automation frameworks and tools such as Selenium, JUnit, TestNG, or similar.
- Proficient in version control systems such as Git.
- Solid understanding of software development methodologies, particularly Agile and Scrum.
- Knowledge of API testing tools like Postman or RestAssured.
- Familiarity with performance testing tools such as JMeter or LoadRunner is a plus.
- Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
- Strong communication skills to collaborate effectively with team members and stakeholders.

Tools Required:
- Selenium or other test automation frameworks.
- JUnit or TestNG for unit testing.
- Git for version control.
- Postman or RestAssured for API testing.
- JMeter or LoadRunner for performance testing.
- Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) tools like Jenkins or CircleCI.
- Bug tracking tools such as JIRA or Bugzilla.

If you are passionate about quality assurance and have a desire to drive excellence in software development, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity at GreyOrange. Join us in building innovative solutions that redefine automation and robotics in supply chain operations.
 Roles and Responsibilities 
About the Role: 
As a Software Development Engineer in Test II at GreyOrange, you will play a crucial role in ensuring software quality through automated testing. You will design, implement, and maintain testing frameworks while collaborating closely with developers to enhance product reliability. This position requires a blend of strong programming skills and a passion for quality assurance.

About the Team: 
You will be part of a dynamic and innovative team focused on developing cutting-edge robotics and automation solutions. The team encourages collaborative problem-solving and continuous improvement. Working in an agile environment, team members are empowered to contribute ideas and influence product development.

You are Responsible for: 
- Developing and maintaining automated test scripts for software quality assurance. 
- Identifying and reporting defects in a systematic manner. 
- Collaborating with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless integration of testing within the development lifecycle. 
- Contributing to the improvement of testing processes and frameworks.

To succeed in this role – you should have the following: 
- A strong background in software development, particularly in testing automation. 
- Proficiency in programming languages such as Java, Python, or similar. 
- Experience with testing tools and frameworks like Selenium, JUnit, or TestNG. 
- Excellent analytical skills and a problem-solving mindset. 
- Strong communication skills to effectively collaborate with team members and stakeholders.

title: Senior Manager - Transformation Management Office
description:
Senior Manager- Transformation Management Office (TMO) About the Role
The Transformation Management Office (TMO) is a dedicated enterprise transformation function within IndiGo's Strategy Office, responsible for driving and coordinating the organization's strategic transformation agenda.
The TMO serves as the central catalyst for execution, governance across cross-functional initiatives that are critical to IndiGo's long-term growth, operational resilience, and strategic priorities. The team works closely with senior leadership, functional heads, and initiative owners across the organization to accelerate delivery, resolve interdependencies, drive accountability, and ensure sustainable adoption of change.
This role offers significant exposure to leadership and opportunity to contribute to some of the most critical transformation programs across the airline. Key Responsibilities
1.    Enterprise Transformation & Program Delivery
•    Support the execution and delivery of strategic, enterprise-wide transformation initiatives across multiple business functions
•    Act as a thought partner to initiative owners by applying structured problem-solving and an outside-in perspective to challenge assumptions, identify gaps, and strengthen project outcomes
•    Track progress against plans, proactively identifying risks, bottlenecks, dependencies, and resource constraints that may impact delivery 
•    Assess continuity post-implementation and monitor realization of planned benefits and business outcomes
2.    Governance & Performance Management
•    Maintain a single source of truth for transformation initiatives through structured governance, reporting, and portfolio tracking 
•    Develop and manage dashboards, scorecards, KPIs, and executive reporting mechanisms to monitor program performance
•    Run periodic transformation review cadence with initiative owners and ensure timely escalation of risks and decisions
•    Support governance forums including Transformation Steering Committee reviews, Executive Committee updates, and Board-level reporting
3.    Cross-Functional Stakeholder Management
•    Coordinate closely with stakeholders across Operations, Network Planning, Engineering, Commercial, Digital, Finance, HR, Customer Experience, Safety, and other business functions
•    Facilitate workshops, reviews, decision forums, and governance meetings to drive alignment and execution
•    Manage interdependencies across initiatives and support resolution of competing priorities and execution challenges
4.    Executive Reviews & Change Management
•    Support preparation of leadership presentations, strategic reviews, and decision-making materials for senior executives
•    Synthesize complex cross-functional inputs into concise, executive-ready recommendations and reporting
•    Support change-management, communication, and stakeholder engagement activities necessary for successful transformation adoption
•    Drive a culture of execution excellence, transparency, and continuous improvement across the transformation portfolio Qualifications & Experience
•    Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Economics, Aviation, Business, or a related discipline; MBA preferred
•    8-10 years of relevant professional experience
•    Experience in management consulting, corporate strategy, transformation, program management, or PMO/TMO environments preferred
•    Demonstrated experience managing cross-functional initiatives involving multiple stakeholders and business functions
•    Exposure to aviation or other complex, operations-intensive industries is advantageous
•    Experience working with senior leadership in fast-paced, high-visibility environments 
Functional Skills
•    Strong analytical and structured problem-solving capability
•    Strong business acumen with understanding of operational and commercial interdependencies
•    Excellent stakeholder management and influencing skills
•    Executive communication and presentation skills
•    Governance, reporting, risk management, and project tracking expertise
•    Ability to operate independently in ambiguous environments while maintaining attention to detail and accountability
Technical Skills
•    Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint
•    Experience with project management, reporting, and portfolio-tracking tools
•    Familiarity with tools such as Jira, MS Project, Power BI, or equivalent platforms is an advantage 
Reporting Structure
The role will be part of the Transformation Management Office and report directly to the Head of TMO, who in turn reports to the Chief Strategy Officer. The position will work closely with initiative owners, functional leaders, and senior management across the organization, providing significant exposure to executive leadership and enterprise-wide strategic priorities

 We are looking for a detail-oriented and proactive Consumables Executive to manage the procurement, inventory, and availability of consumable materials required for day-to-day operations. The role involves coordinating with internal teams and vendors to ensure timely availability of consumables while maintaining optimal stock levels and controlling costs. Location: Gurgaon Role: Consumables Executive

 Manage the day-to-day procurement and availability of consumable items required for operations. Maintain accurate inventory records and monitor stock levels regularly. Raise purchase requests/orders based on operational requirements. Coordinate with vendors and suppliers for quotations, orders, deliveries, and follow-ups. Prepare regular inventory and procurement reports for management. Support audits and ensure compliance with company procurement and inventory processes.

Good knowledge of MS Excel / Google Sheets. Strong vendor coordination and negotiation skills. Good numerical and analytical abilities. Strong attention to detail and accuracy in maintaining records. Good communication and interpersonal skills. Ability to coordinate with multiple teams and manage priorities. Proactive approach with strong follow-up skills. Ability to work in a fast-paced operational environment.

Insights & Enablement (I&E) within Services

-Drive operational excellence

Role Overview
Reporting to the Director, Services BD Insights & Enablement, the Analyst will play a key role in supporting the implementation and ongoing evolution of the Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) platform for the Services organization.

The role will focus on cost optimization, supplier development, inventory availability, quality compliance, and uninterrupted production operations. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 A. Procurement & Strategic Sourcing Develop and implement procurement strategies aligned with production plans, business requirements, and company objectives. Manage end-to-end purchasing of food ingredients, raw materials, packaging materials, consumables, and other operational supplies. Identify, evaluate, negotiate with, and develop reliable suppliers and vendors. Obtain competitive quotations, conduct price comparisons, and negotiate pricing, payment terms, delivery schedules, and other commercial conditions. Ensure timely procurement to avoid production delays and material shortages. Develop alternate sources of supply to minimize procurement risks and dependency on individual vendors. B. Cost Control & Savings Drive cost reduction through strategic sourcing, bulk purchasing, rate contracts, and supplier negotiations. Monitor commodity price trends, market movements, and changes in raw material costs. Prepare and track procurement budgets, purchase cost reports, and savings initiatives. Analyze purchase price variances and take corrective actions to control procurement expenditure. C. Supplier Management Establish and maintain strong relationships with suppliers, manufacturers, distributors, and service providers. Conduct supplier evaluations based on quality, price, delivery performance, reliability, and service. Monitor vendor performance and resolve issues related to delayed supplies, price discrepancies, and material quality. Coordinate supplier audits and assessments in collaboration with the Quality Assurance team. D. Food Safety & Quality Compliance Ensure purchased materials comply with approved specifications, food safety requirements, and applicable regulatory standards. Coordinate with Quality Assurance for supplier approval, material specifications, certificates of analysis, and other required documentation. Ensure appropriate traceability and documentation for ingredients and packaging materials. Support compliance with applicable FSSAI requirements, HACCP, GMP, and other relevant food safety systems, as applicable to the business. Ensure non-conforming materials are addressed through appropriate supplier corrective actions and replacement procedures. E. Inventory & Production Coordination Coordinate with Production, Planning, Stores, Quality Assurance, Finance, and Logistics teams to ensure material availability. Plan purchases based on production schedules, demand forecasts, stock levels, lead times, and minimum order quantities. Monitor inventory levels to prevent stockouts, overstocking, expiry, and material obsolescence. Support effective inventory control through reorder levels, safety stock planning, and periodic stock reviews. F. Purchase Operations & Documentation Oversee purchase requisitions, requests for quotations, comparative statements, purchase orders, and order tracking. Ensure purchases are made as per approved budgets, authorization limits, and company procurement policies. Maintain accurate vendor databases, contracts, price lists, and procurement records. Coordinate with Finance and Accounts for invoice verification, purchase order matching, payment follow-ups, and vendor reconciliations. Develop periodic procurement reports and present key performance indicators to management. G. Team Management & Process Improvement Lead, guide, and develop the purchase team to achieve departmental objectives. Establish standard operating procedures and improve procurement processes. Promote ethical purchasing practices, transparency, accountability, and compliance with company policies. Identify opportunities to improve procurement systems, reporting, and digital purchasing workflows. 3. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Procurement cost savings against approved budgets and benchmarks. On-time delivery of materials to meet production requirements. Material stockout frequency and production losses attributable to procurement. Supplier quality performance and rejection rates. Purchase price variance and adherence to negotiated rates. Inventory holding levels and reduction in excess or expired stock. Purchase order processing turnaround time. Supplier performance and compliance with approved procurement procedures. 4. Qualifications & Experience Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Engineering, or a related discipline. MBA in Supply Chain Management or a relevant postgraduate qualification will be an added advantage. Approximately 812 years of relevant experience in purchase, procurement, or strategic sourcing, preferably in food manufacturing, food processing, FMCG, or a related industry. Prior experience handling raw materials, food ingredients, packaging materials, and manufacturing procurement is preferred. Experience in vendor development, commercial negotiations, cost control, inventory planning, and procurement reporting. Working knowledge of ERP systems, inventory management, and Microsoft Excel. 5. Required Skills & Competencies Strong negotiation and commercial decision-making skills. Excellent supplier relationship and vendor development capabilities. Analytical skills for cost evaluation, market research, and price benchmarking. Sound understanding of procurement processes and inventory management. Knowledge of food industry quality, safety, and regulatory requirements. Strong coordination, communication, and team leadership skills. High standards of integrity, accountability, and professional ethics. Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively under production deadlines.

The role ensures system stability, security, and performance by managing day-to-day operations, troubleshooting incidents, and supporting infrastructure upgrades. 
 Technical Skills Required Linux Administration Strong hands-on experience with RHEL/CentOS/Oracle Linux. User, process, memory, and file system management. Shell scripting and automation. Performance tuning and troubleshooting. Network and security administration in Linux environments. Oracle Database Administration Oracle Database installation, configuration, and patching. Backup and recovery using RMAN. Database performance monitoring and tuning. User, schema, and privilege management. Experience with Oracle HA/DR solutions is preferred. 
 System Administration Install, configure, and maintain Windows / Linux / Unix servers . Manage user accounts, permissions, and system access in compliance with policies. Apply OS patches, upgrades, and security updates on a regular schedule. Monitoring & Performance Monitor system performance, availability, and resource utilization. Conduct regular health checks and ensure compliance with SLAs. Troubleshoot OS-related issues and provide root cause analysis. Security & Compliance Implement and maintain system security (hardening, access control, vulnerability patching). Support audits and compliance requirements Maintain system backup, recovery, and disaster recovery readiness. Operations & Support Provide L2/L3 support for OS-related incidents. Automate routine tasks using scripts (Shell, PowerShell, Python). Maintain documentation of system configurations, SOPs, and changes. Collaboration Work closely with network, storage, and application teams for issue resolution. Support infrastructure projects, migrations, and capacity planning. Required Skills & Qualifications Bachelors degree in Computer Science, IT, Electronics, or related field. 35 years of experience in Linux / Windows / Unix administration . Strong knowledge of system performance tuning, patch management, and log analysis. Familiarity with virtualization platforms (VMware, Hyper-V, KVM). Understanding of security hardening, firewalls, and endpoint protection. Proficiency in scripting (Bash, PowerShell, Python preferred). 
 Key Responsibilities Provide L2 support for Linux servers and Oracle database environments. Troubleshoot and resolve production incidents within defined SLAs.
