title: Sr. Manager - Aftersales Operations
description:
Badshahpur, Gurugram Full Time About Us Noise was built on a simple belief: India can build world-class consumer tech. Founded in 2014 by Amit Khatri and Gaurav Khatri, Noise began with a mission to democratize connected technology for every Indian. Today, we are Indias #1 smartwatch brand and #2 in TWS audio, with 40M+ users - and now backed by Bose as a strategic investor. Noises journey of innovation and impact has earned recognition both nationally and globally, with prestigious honours including the Economic Times Startup Award (2022), Forbes Leadership Awards (2023), Red Dot Design Award (2024), and Mobile India Awards (2025). The next phase is sharper: building a globally relevant, AI-native company where every function compounds leverage, not headcount. Join us as we continue to shape the sound of tomorrow! Your Will Bes We are looking for an experienced and hands-on Senior Manager - Aftersales Operations to own and drive the end-to-end Repair, Replacement, QC, Product Testing and Dispatch Operations across Audio, Wearables and other consumer electronics categories. The role will be responsible for ensuring that products received through customer returns, service centres, warehouses and other channels are accurately received, inspected, tested, repaired/replaced where applicable, dispositioned and dispatched within defined TATs, along with management of spares and inventory through the OMS platform. The individual will work closely with Customer Experience, Warehouse, Inventory, Logistics, Quality, Product, Technology and external service partners to ensure seamless execution of the aftersales lifecycle. This role requires a strong combination of operations management, technical understanding, QC expertise, inventory discipline, data analysis, process improvement and people leadership. 1. End-to-End Repair Replacement Operations Own the complete repair and replacement lifecycle from receipt of returned/defective products to final closure. Define and manage processes for product receiving, physical verification, serial number validation, QC inspection, functional testing, repair assessment, replacement approval, product disposition, inventory reconciliation and final dispatch through CRM. Establish clear SOPs and process controls to minimize leakage, delays, wrong replacements and incorrect dispositions. Ensure replacement products are dispatched within committed customer TAT. 2. Product QC Testing - Audio, Wearables Other Categories Own pre-dispatch and post-return QC/testing for Audio, Wearables and other consumer electronics categories. Define category-wise testing protocols and checklists for TWS/Earbuds, Headphones/Neckbands, Speakers/Audio products, Smartwatches/Smart Bands, Power Banks and other electronic accessories and NPD categories. Ensure complete functional testing before replacement dispatch, refurbishment, restocking, repair closure or customer shipment. Build testing parameters covering battery performance, charging, Bluetooth/pairing, audio output, microphone, touch/buttons, sensors, display, connectivity, app synchronization, physical condition, accessories and packaging. Ensure products failing QC are correctly segregated and do not enter saleable/replacement inventory. Continuously improve testing methodology based on emerging customer complaints and product defect trends. 3. Replacement Product Dispatch Management Own replacement dispatch readiness and ensure only QC-approved products are dispatched. Maintain controls around product model, SKU, serial number, colour/variant, product condition, accessories and packaging. Coordinate with Warehouse and Inventory teams to ensure replacement stock is available and accurately reflected in the system. Establish daily dispatch plans based on ageing and customer commitment. Track pending replacement cases and ensure there are no avoidable ageing cases. Identify bottlenecks causing delays in replacement dispatch and implement corrective actions. 4. TAT Management Own and monitor end-to-end aftersales TAT across receiving, QC, repair, replacement and dispatch. Define stage-wise TATs and SLAs for product receiving, QC inspection, technical testing, repair assessment, replacement approval, inventory allocation and dispatch. Maintain daily ageing dashboards and ensure cases crossing SLA are immediately escalated. Drive a culture of zero avoidable ageing within the team. Identify root causes of TAT breaches and implement preventive measures. Publish daily/weekly TAT performance reports to senior leadership. Key TAT Metrics tracked: Overall Repair TAT, Replacement TAT, QC TAT; Receiving-to-QC TAT, QC-to-Dispatch TAT; Average Ageing, Cases > SLA; First-Time-Right QC %, Dispatch SLA adherence %. 5. Returns Reverse Logistics Management Own the operational strategy for products returning from customers, service centres, marketplaces and other channels. Analyse return volumes and identify major drivers. Ensure returned products are correctly classified into Repairable, Replaceable, NTF/No Trouble Found, Physical Damage, Liquid Damage, Manufacturing Defect, Refurbishable, Scrap/Non-recoverable and Restockable. Ensure proper disposition and system closure of every returned unit. Work with Logistics and Warehouse teams to reduce reverse-logistics TAT and cost. 6. Root Cause Analysis Defect Reduction Analyse product return and QC data to identify recurring product and process failures. Build RCA dashboards covering top complaint reasons, top defective SKUs, product/category-wise failure rates, NTF %, repeat failure %, repair failure %, QC rejection %, replacement rate and return rate. Partner with Product, Quality, Engineering and NPD teams to identify systemic product issues. Convert customer complaint data into actionable product improvement recommendations. Track corrective and preventive actions until closure. Identify opportunities to reduce unnecessary replacements, repairs and returns. 7. Customer Experience Partnership Work closely with Customer Experience / Customer Service leadership to ensure operational issues do not negatively impact customer experience. Create clear escalation mechanisms between CX and Aftersales Operations. Ensure customer commitments made by CX teams are operationally achievable and tracked. Provide CX teams with accurate visibility on product availability, repair status, replacement status, QC status, dispatch status and expected TAT. Support CX escalations involving delayed repairs, replacement delays, product quality concerns and exceptional cases. 8. Warehouse Inventory Management Partner closely with Warehouse and Inventory teams to maintain 100% stock accuracy for repair and replacement inventory. Ensure proper segregation of fresh stock, replacement stock, returned stock, repairable stock, refurbished stock, QC hold stock, defective stock and scrap stock. Monitor physical vs system inventory reconciliation. Ensure no product is dispatched without appropriate system and QC clearance. Minimize inventory ageing and unidentified inventory. Establish controls for serial-number-level inventory tracking. 9. Team Management Leadership Lead and manage QC Engineers, QC Specialists, Inventory Associates and Aftersales Operations Associates. Define manpower requirements based on business volumes and workload. Hire, train, coach and develop team members. Establish individual and team-level performance KPIs. Conduct regular performance reviews and provide structured feedback. Manage daily manpower planning and workload allocation. Ensure adequate staffing during peak periods and product launches. Build technical capability within the QC team through regular training and certification. Establish accountability at individual process stages. 10. Process Excellence Automation Continuously identify opportunities to simplify and automate aftersales processes. Work with Technology/Product/Engineering teams to improve RMS and internal systems. Drive automation for product receiving, serial number validation, QC status, inventory movement, repair tracking, replacement allocation, dispatch readiness, TAT alerts, ageing alerts and reporting dashboards. Eliminate manual trackers wherever system-based solutions are feasible. Develop robust SOPs, process maps, escalation matrices and control mechanisms. 11. Cost Management Identify opportunities to reduce the cost of repairs, replacements, reverse logistics, packaging, inventory handling, manpower, refurbishment and scrap. Monitor cost per return, cost per repair and cost per replacement. Reduce unnecessary replacements through better diagnosis and testing. Improve recovery from returned products through refurbishment/restocking wherever commercially and operationally viable. Track savings generated through process improvement initiatives. 12. Escalation Exception Management Own critical operational escalations related to delayed replacements, delayed repairs, QC disputes, wrong product dispatch, inventory mismatch, repeated product failures, customer escalations and partner/service-centre disputes. Establish an escalation matrix with clear ownership and resolution timelines. Ensure high-priority cases receive immediate action and do not age unnecessarily. Work with CX leadership on customer-sensitive cases requiring exceptional intervention. 13. MIS, Analytics Senior Management Reporting Daily dashboards covering: products received, products under QC, QC completed; repair pending, replacement pending, dispatch pending; cases ageing beyond SLA, inventory availability and QC rejection rate. Weekly/Monthly dashboards covering: return rate, replacement rate, repair rate, NTF %; QC pass %, QC rejection %, restock rate, refurbishment recovery %; average TAT, SLA adherence; cost per return, cost per repair, cost per replacement; product/category-wise defect trends, top RCA drivers and team productivity. Present actionable insights to senior management rather than only reporting numbers - highlighting key risks, gaps, corrective actions and expected business impact. The Ideal Noisemaker 10-12+ years of relevant experience in Aftersales, Repair Operations, QC, Returns, Reverse Logistics, Warehouse Operations or Consumer Electronics. Experience managing Audio, Wearables, Mobile Accessories or consumer electronics preferred. Experience managing QC/testing teams and warehouse/inventory operations. Strong experience in Repair Replacement / RMA / Returns Management. Experience working with RMS/WMS or other inventory and aftersales systems. Strong understanding of consumer electronics QC and testing, and the ability to define QC protocols and testing checklists. Strong knowledge of inventory, reverse logistics, and serial-number/SKU-level inventory management. Strong knowledge of TAT/SLA management, with strong analytical and problem-solving capability. Advanced Excel / Google Sheets skills, with experience creating operational dashboards and MIS. Strong people-management, team-building and stakeholder-management skills - able to work with CX, Warehouse, Logistics, Product, Quality and Technology teams. Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to operate effectively in a high-volume, fast-paced environment. Key Performance Indicators Replacement TAT Repair TAT - maintain agreed SLA. QC TAT - same-day / defined SLA adherence. Dispatch TAT - timely dispatch of QC-approved units. SLA Adherence - maximize; Ageing Cases - minimize. QC Accuracy First-Time-Right QC - maximize. Inventory Accuracy - 100% system vs physical reconciliation. NTF % - reduce through better diagnosis. Return Rate - reduce through RCA; Restock Rate - improve where applicable. Cost per Return / Cost per Repair - reduce and optimize. Replacement Leakage - minimize. Team Productivity - improve; Process Compliance - 100% adherence. Leadership Expectations The successful candidate will be expected to operate as the owner of Aftersales Operations, not merely as a process manager. The individual should be able to: Identify operational gaps independently and build scalable processes from the ground up. Use data to identify problems and drive decisions. Balance Customer Experience, Quality, TAT and Cost. Build strong accountability within the team, and challenge existing processes to continuously improve them. Convert recurring customer complaints into operational and product improvements. Drive cross-functional projects to closure, and build systems and processes that can scale with business growth. Candidate Profile Educational Qualification Bachelors degree in Operations, Supply Chain, Engineering, Business Administration, Electronics or a related field. MBA / PG qualification in Operations or Supply Chain would be an advantage.

description:
Job Summary 
 The IBM Spectrum Scale (GPFS) Administrator will be responsible for the administration, configuration, troubleshooting, and optimization of enterprise-scale storage environments, with a strong focus on IBM Spectrum Scale (GPFS) and Linux-based infrastructure. The role involves managing GPFS clusters, filesystems, NSDs, storage pools, policies, quotas, replication, and high-availability configurations. The position requires strong hands-on expertise in GPFS architecture, SAN/NAS storage, NFS/SMB, RAID, LVM, multipathing, and Linux storage administration , along with the ability to troubleshoot complex storage, performance, networking, and filesystem issues. The candidate will monitor cluster health and storage performance, perform upgrades and capacity expansions with minimal disruption, and conduct detailed root-cause analysis (RCA) for storage incidents. The role will also collaborate closely with server, network, operating system, application, and HPC/AI teams to deliver reliable and high-performance storage solutions. Experience with HPC/AI environments, Slurm, Kubernetes/OpenShift, InfiniBand/RDMA, or high-speed Ethernet will be an added advantage. Strong scripting, automation, documentation, and incident-management skills are expected. 
 Key Responsibilities: 
 Hands-on administration and troubleshooting of IBM Spectrum Scale (GPFS) environments. Install, configure, upgrade, and maintain GPFS clusters, filesystems, NSDs, and storage pools. Configure and troubleshoot GPFS nodes, quorum/manager nodes, NSD servers, and client nodes . Manage GPFS filesystem creation, mounting, policies, quotas, replication, and performance tuning. Troubleshoot GPFS issues related to I/O performance, node failures, filesystem availability, disk/NSD failures, and network connectivity . Strong understanding of SAN, NAS, NFS, SMB, Fibre Channel, iSCSI, and Ethernet storage networks . Experience with Linux storage administration , LVM, multipathing, RAID, disk management, and filesystem troubleshooting. Monitor storage capacity, IOPS, latency, throughput, and overall cluster health. Perform GPFS upgrades, patches, configuration changes, and capacity expansion with minimum service disruption. Analyze GPFS logs and Linux system logs and perform root-cause analysis for storage incidents. Work with server, network, OS, and application teams for end-to-end storage issue resolution. Prepare technical documentation, RCA, health reports, and operational procedures. 
 Mandatory Skills 
 Strong hands-on experience in IBM Spectrum Scale / GPFS Linux administration, preferably RHEL GPFS architecture, NSD, quorum, CES, filesets, pools, and policies SAN/NAS storage concepts RAID, LVM, multipathing, NFS/SMB Storage performance monitoring and troubleshooting Shell scripting and basic automation Good troubleshooting and incident-management skills. 
 Good to Have 
 Experience with HPC/AI/GPU infrastructure GPFS integration with Slurm, Kubernetes/OpenShift, or HPC clusters Experience with InfiniBand/RDMA or high-speed Ethernet Experience with enterprise storage platforms such as Dell, NetApp, Lenovo, HPE, or IBM IBM Spectrum Scale certification or equivalent hands-on experience

title: Sr Category Manager :: Leading Consumer appliances Brand
description:
Role & responsibilities 

 As the Senior Category Manager - Marketing, you will have end-to-end strategic, financial, and operational ownership of your assigned product category. You will blend consumer insights, product strategy, and data-driven marketing to launch new products, optimize the existing portfolio, and drive market share. This role requires an agile leader who can seamlessly navigate between long-term product roadmapping, rigorous P&L management, consumer research, and ground-level trade enablement. You will be fully accountable for driving market share, optimizing product mix, and ensuring flawless go-to-market execution. Key Responsibilities: 1. Annual & Long-Term Strategic Planning Annual Business Planning: Draft and execute the annual category plan, taking absolute ownership of core metrics including market share expansion, volume growth, and margin delivery. 3-Year Product Roadmap: Define and maintain a robust 3-year product pipeline and portfolio roadmap, backed comprehensively by consumer learnings and competitive insights. Data-Driven Growth: Continuously analyze primary and secondary market research data alongside market share trends to identify untapped growth opportunities. 2. Financial Management & Project Accountability Project Financials: Own the financial decision-making process for category projects, evaluating and passing them based on stringent ROI and payback period benchmarks. The Project Triangle: Direct and manage product development and marketing initiatives to ensure all projects strictly satisfy the Cost-Quality-Time triangle. 3. Consumer Insights, Positioning & Communication Direct Consumer Engagement: Regularly meet and interface with consumers on-ground to extract deep insights on how to improve existing product offerings and identify pipeline innovations. Value Proposition & Brand Control: Define and validate the right consumer proposition for the category. Retain end-to-end control over all marketing, brand, and product communication to ensure messaging consistency and brand compliance. Competitive Pricing & Fit: Monitor and analyze competitive landscapes continuously to ensure Whirlpools offerings are perfectly positioned regarding product-price fit across all segments. 4. Demand Optimization & GTM Execution Demand Forecasting: Partner closely with supply chain and commercial planning teams to ensure highly accurate demand forecasting, balancing optimum market availability against inventory costs. Robust GTM Strategy: Architect and lead end-to-end, high-impact Go-To-Market (GTM) plans for all new product launches to maximize day-one velocity.

title: Quality Engineer
description:
Job Purpose 
 The Quality Engineer is responsible for ensuring end-to-end product and process quality across Incoming Material Inspection, Fabrication, Welding, Assembly and Pre-Dispatch Inspection (PDI). The role will ensure compliance with approved drawings, specifications, Inspection & Test Plans (ITPs), Quality Plans, WPS/PQR, welder qualifications, applicable welding standards/codes and company quality procedures. The position will also be responsible for supplier quality, customer complaints, RCA/CAPA, audits, documentation, calibration, continuous improvement and quality performance management. The Quality Engineer will work closely with Production, Welding/Fabrication, Engineering, Procurement, Suppliers, Projects and Customers to achieve quality targets, reduce rejection/rework and ensure timely delivery of conforming products. 
 Role & responsibilities 1. Overall Quality Management & In-Process Quality Assurance Plan, monitor and control quality activities across Incoming, Fabrication, Welding, Assembly and PDI. Ensure achievement of monthly quality targets and departmental quality objectives. Monitor internal rejection, rework, repair and defect rates and initiate corrective actions. Ensure manufacturing activities are carried out in accordance with approved drawings, specifications, Quality Plans, SOPs and inspection procedures. Conduct stage-wise inspection and ensure quality clearance before proceeding to subsequent manufacturing operations. Identify process deviations and ensure timely containment and corrective action Coordinate with Production and Engineering for resolution of quality issues affecting production and delivery. Maintain proper inspection records and product traceability throughout the manufacturing cycle. 2. Welding & Fabrication Quality Management Monitor and ensure welding activities are performed in accordance with approved WPS/PQR and applicable codes, standards and project specifications. Review welding parameters, joint preparation, fit-up, alignment, root gap, bevel angle and cleanliness before welding. Verify compliance with specified preheating, inter pass temperature, heat input and welding parameters, where applicable. Monitor weld repair activities and ensure repaired welds are re-inspected as per approved procedures. Verify welding machine/equipment condition and calibration status where applicable. Ensure compliance with approved welding sequences and fabrication procedures. Support preparation, review and implementation of WPS/PQR, welding inspection procedures and weld maps. Coordinate with welding supervisors, fabricators and production teams to prevent recurring welding defects, minimize distortion, and ensure continuous workflow. 3. Quality Documentation & QMS Prepare, review, and maintain critical quality documents including Quality Control Plans (QCP), Inspection & Test Plans (ITPs), final Manufacturing Data Records (MDR), and Data Dossiers. Lead problem-solving documentation for Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA) using standard frameworks (8D, 5-Why, Ishikawa). Ensure shop-floor adherence to ISO 9001 Quality Management System standards and support internal/external quality audits. Manage equipment calibration schedules, generate dimensional/NDT reports, and formalize PDI (Pre-Dispatch Inspection) clearance certificates. 4. Advanced Welding Knowledge Technical understanding of multiple welding processes, including GTAW (TIG) & MIG. Working knowledge of Non-Destructive Testing (NDT) methodologies Penetrant Testing (PT), Magnetic Particle Testing (MT), Ultrasonic Testing (UT), and Radiographic Testing (RT). ASNT Level II 5. Manufacturing & Fabrication Process Knowledge High proficiency in reading and inspecting against complex mechanical blueprints, including thorough knowledge of Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing (GD&T). Strong understanding of heavy fabrication sequences, sheet metal processing, shearing, bending, rolling, and fundamental machining operations. Expertise in using and validating precision measuring instruments ( Vernier calipers, micrometers, height gauges etc).

Key Skills: Fabrication,Quality,QMS,Quality Control,Qa/Qc,Welding

Role & responsibilities 
 JOB DESCRIPTION QUALITY ENGINEER Position: Quality Engineer Department: Quality Assurance / Quality Control
 Industry: Manufacturing Moulding, Fabrication & Electrical Components
 Experience: 2–5 Years
 Location: [Location]
 Reporting To: Quality Manager / Head – Quality 1. JOB PURPOSE To ensure that raw materials, in-process production, and finished products meet defined quality standards, customer specifications, drawings, and company requirements. The Quality Engineer will be responsible for implementing quality systems, identifying and resolving quality issues, reducing rejection and rework, and continuously improving manufacturing processes. The candidate should have practical knowledge of plastic moulding, fabrication processes, and electrical components . 2. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES A. Incoming Quality Control Inspect incoming raw materials, bought-out components, electrical components, and fabricated parts. Verify materials against approved specifications, drawings, purchase requirements, and inspection standards. Conduct dimensional, visual, functional, and material inspections as applicable. Maintain incoming inspection records and supplier quality documentation. Identify and report non-conforming materials and coordinate corrective actions with suppliers. B. In-Process Quality Control Monitor quality at various stages of manufacturing, including:
 Plastic injection moulding Fabrication Assembly Electrical component assembly Other production processes as applicable. Conduct first-piece, patrol, and final inspections. Ensure critical dimensions and process parameters are maintained. Monitor moulding defects such as short moulding, sink marks, flash, warpage, burn marks, flow marks, and dimensional variation. Inspect fabricated components for dimensional accuracy, welding quality, surface finish, holes, bends, and assembly accuracy. Check electrical components for correct specifications, assembly, connections, and functionality. C. Final Quality Inspection Inspect finished products according to approved drawings, specifications, control plans, and customer requirements. Ensure products are released only after meeting defined quality standards. Prepare inspection reports and maintain quality records. Support dispatch clearance and customer-specific inspection requirements. D. Quality Documentation Prepare and maintain:
 Inspection Reports First Piece Inspection Reports In-Process Inspection Records Final Inspection Reports Control Plans Check Sheets Corrective & Preventive Action (CAPA) records Rejection and rework reports Maintain proper traceability of quality records. E. Problem Solving & Corrective Action Identify root causes of internal and customer quality issues. Use quality tools such as:

title: Assistant Manager, Business Insights
description:
The Assistant Manager - Business Insights will assist in leading and managing projects aimed at improving business processes and systems. This role involves working closely with different departments to analyze current processes, identify areas for improvement, and develop and implement solutions that enhance efficiency, quality, and customer satisfaction. 
 
 What You'll Do: 
 Opportunity identification on the ground: Continuously scan the operations to surface improvement avenues, inefficiencies, and performance gaps, and maintain a prioritized pipeline of opportunities backed by data and operational evidence. Problem framing: Partner with the account team and functional owners to convert vague asks and observed pain points into sharp, scoped problem statements with clear business impact and decision needs. Diagnostics & root-cause analysis: Run structured deep dives using data analysis, process walkthroughs, floor observation, segmentation, and Lean Six Sigma methods to move from symptoms to underlying drivers. Analysis & optimization: Build and maintain the analysis that drives decisions on the account - performance trends, driver analysis, and scenario comparisons - and translate findings into concrete optimization actions. Data & analytical quality: Validate data availability, definitions, and reliability; reconcile conflicting sources; document assumptions and limitations; and assure the accuracy and reproducibility of analytical outputs. Solution enablement & implementation support: Shape practical recommendations and support their implementation on the ground - coordinating owners, timelines, and dependencies so improvements are actually executed. Commercial & account insight: Connect findings to account economics - productivity, cost-to-serve, SLA/KPI exposure, quality, and client-impact implications. Technology & process enablement: Identify where recurring problems can be addressed through dashboards, trackers, automation, or process redesign; define clear requirements and partner with development resources on delivery. Adoption & impact tracking: Establish baselines, track adoption and action closure, and measure before/after business impact so improvements stick and benefits are evidenced. Reporting & decision support: Translate analysis into concise, decision-ready narratives and flags for account reviews and for the Assistant Manager / Manager, Business Insights.

description:
Senior HVAC/MEP Design Engineer Industrial Projects We are looking for a Senior HVAC/MEP Design Engineer with strong hands-on design experience to join our growing team. The role involves working on industrial projects from concept and calculations through detailed design, BIM modelling and engineering documentation. The successful candidate will work independently under technical leadership, take ownership of assigned deliverables and collaborate closely with structural, electrical, automation and other engineering disciplines. Key Responsibilities Perform HVAC calculations including heating/cooling loads, airflow, pressure losses, duct sizing, ventilation and indoor pressure requirements . Design HVAC, plumbing, drainage, utilities and related MEP systems for industrial facilities. Develop coordinated Revit MEP models , layouts, schematics, P&IDs and IFC/construction drawings. Prepare equipment schedules, datasheets, specifications, BOM/MTO and calculation reports . Design and coordinate compressed-air piping, safety-shower connections and other mechanical interfaces. Coordinate with structural, electrical, automation and equipment-supplier disciplines, considering supports, penetrations and constructability . Maintain high standards of technical quality and documentation while completing deliverables independently. Collaborate with colleagues and project teams in Sweden and contribute to effective client communication. Qualifications & Experience Degree/Diploma in Mechanical Engineering, HVAC or a related discipline . 5 - 12 years of relevant HVAC/MEP detailed-design experience , preferably in industrial buildings, laboratories, steel plants or similar facilities. title: Merchandise Manager
description:
ABOUT THIS ROLE 
 We make in China and in India, and we carry roughly sixty days between paying for inventory and selling it. That number is the single most expensive fact about our business. Every week a shipment slips, every carton that arrives wrong, every clearance that stalls at customs, comes straight out of it. 
 This role exists to protect that. You will work directly , who owns supplier sourcing and production, and you will run the tracking layer underneath him. Where every open order actually is, against where it was promised. What is needed for it to clear customs and land at the Delhi office. What we check before we accept it. When something is going to be late, you are the person who knows first and says so early, while there is still time to do something about it. 
 It is a detail role and it is unglamorous, and it is also the job that decides whether 125 SKUs are on the shelf when a campaign goes live. You should be the kind of person who finds a quiet satisfaction in a clean checklist and an honest tracker. 
 What you'll own The live production tracker across every open order, India and China, against committed dates Import and compliance documentation. Invoices, packing lists, BOE, HS classification, customs paperwork, and the coordination that gets a container cleared without a scramble The QC protocol. Building the inspection checklist per product, running pre-dispatch and inward checks, and holding the line when a batch does not meet it Defect logging and the loop back to the supplier, so the same fault does not arrive twice Packaging and consumables availability alongside , so a finished good never waits on a box The weekly production status report the founders and the warehouse plan against Inward coordination with operations team, so what lands is what the system expects 
 What we're looking for 3 to 6 years in production, merchandising, sourcing or supply chain for a physical product brand. Bags, leather goods, accessories, hard goods or apparel You have tracked live orders against dates and chased suppliers who were slipping. This is the core of the job Working knowledge of Indian import: customs documentation, duty, HS codes, freight forwarders, clearance timelines You can write and run a QC checklist, and you are comfortable rejecting a batch Genuinely strong in Excel or Sheets. Trackers, pivots, reconciliation Organised, direct, and hard to fluster. Suppliers will tell you what you want to hear, and you will need to check 
 Nice to have You have worked with Chinese suppliers and know how that communication actually goes Experience with an ERP or inventory system such as Unicommerce You have been part of moving production from one country to another

Key Skills: Merchant Activities,Merchandising Strategies,Merchandise Planning,Online Merchandising,Retail Merchandising,Merchandising,Planning,Management

title: Associate Logistics
description:
Role Objective 
 The Associate - Logistics will be responsible for managing and improving courier performance across delivery, NDR, RTO, SLA adherence, customer-impact metrics, and operational escalations . The role will work closely with courier partners, Customer Support, Warehouse, Product, and internal Logistics teams to ensure that courier performance gaps are identified early, challenged with data, and driven to closure. The key objective is to ensure high delivery success, lower RTO, better TAT, minimal operational leakage, and strong courier accountability . 
 Key Responsibilities 1. Courier Performance Monitoring Monitor courier-wise performance on a daily basis across key metrics such as: Delivery % RTO % NDR % NDR conversion First-attempt delivery % Delivery TAT Ageing shipments SLA adherence Fake / incorrect attempts Customer complaints Identify deterioration in courier performance and take immediate corrective action. Track performance at courier, hub, pincode, zone, and shipment level wherever required. Maintain daily and weekly courier scorecards and highlight underperforming lanes or partners. Compare actual courier performance against agreed benchmarks and SLAs. 2. Courier Escalation Closure Act as the primary operational point of contact for assigned courier partners. Aggressively follow up on delayed, ageing, stuck, misrouted, or incorrectly updated shipments. Escalate recurring courier issues to the appropriate courier SPOCs and internal stakeholders. Challenge: Fake delivery attempts Incorrect NDR remarks Premature RTO Missed reattempts False customer-unavailable updates Operational delays Ensure every escalation has: Clear ownership Defined action Closure timeline Verified outcome Do not consider a case closed merely because it has been escalated; closure should mean that the required action has actually been completed. 
 3. NDR RTO Performance Management Track NDR performance across courier partners and identify high-risk cases. Ensure timely reattempts and appropriate courier action based on customer confirmation. Coordinate with Customer Support for customer-side closure and required delivery instructions. Identify avoidable RTO caused by courier or internal process gaps. Track courier-wise and pincode-wise RTO trends and initiate corrective actions. Support initiatives aimed at improving NDR-to-delivery conversion and reducing avoidable RTO. 4. Delivery TAT SLA Control Track dispatch-to-delivery performance against committed TAT. Identify shipment ageing and delivery delays before they become customer escalations. Monitor courier adherence to pickup, first attempt, reattempt, and delivery SLAs. Escalate abnormal delays by courier, hub, or geography. Work with courier partners on recovery plans where service levels consistently deteriorate. Maintain visibility of SLA breaches and ensure repeated issues are escalated appropriately. 5. Cross-Functional Coordination Coordinate with Warehouse teams for pickup, handover, manifest, and dispatch-related issues. Work with Customer Support for customer feedback, address correction, refusal validation, and delivery coordination. Coordinate with Product / Technology teams where systemic courier issues require process or platform improvements. Ensure there is no ambiguity in ownership between internal teams and courier partners. Drive closure of cross-functional dependencies impacting shipment performance. 
 Key Traits Required Strong follow-up and ownership mindset. Comfortable holding courier partners accountable. Data-oriented and comfortable identifying performance deterioration. Ability to work with high shipment volumes and multiple courier partners. Strong coordination and stakeholder-management skills. High attention to detail. Ability to escalate firmly but professionally. Strong bias toward closure rather than only reporting problems. Comfortable working in a fast-paced ecommerce environment. 
 Skills Required Good understanding of ecommerce logistics, last-mile delivery, NDR, and RTO. Strong working knowledge of Excel / Google Sheets. Ability to analyze operational reports and courier MIS. Good verbal and written communication skills. Experience working with courier dashboards, logistics aggregators, or shipment management platforms preferred. Basic knowledge of courier rate cards, zones, weight slabs, and billing will be an advantage. 
 Qualification Experience 
 Graduate in any discipline. 1-3 years of experience in ecommerce logistics, courier operations, last-mile operations, or supply-chain operations. Experience with a D2C brand, ecommerce company, logistics aggregator, or courier company preferred. Candidates with hands-on experience managing multiple courier partners will be preferred. 
 Work Experience: 1-3 years Working days: Monday - Saturday Location: Head Office - Okhla Phase 1 - Delhi

title: Apprenticeship - Customer Service (Voice Role)
description:
A DGT Representative operates as a pivotal point of contact for cardmembers (CMs) facing transactional concerns, ranging from merchant disputes to unidentified charges. The role is multifaceted, encompassing root cause analysis, dispute resolution strategy, and compliance adherence to safeguard both customer satisfaction and organizational integrity. Responsibilities Dispute Resolution & Mediation: Proactively mitigate Card Member disputes by guiding customers through resolution strategies such as merchant portal navigation and transaction clarification, aiming for high first-contact resolution. Act as a mediator between Card Members and Merchants to ensure accurate, compliant outcomes through thorough research and analysis in alignment with Regulation Z and the Fair Credit Billing Act (FCBA). Consultative Partnership & Financial Impact: Serve as a consultant and conciliator between Card Members and American Express to gather evidence, communicate resolutions clearly, and recommend alternative solutions that minimize financial write-offs and support long-term customer satisfaction. Analytical Case Resolution: Conduct in-depth analysis of Card Member concerns using structured probing techniques to distinguish legitimate disputes from potential fraud, ensuring accurate case categorization and processing in alignment with GDM and FCIA protocols for efficient downstream handling. Dispute Lifecycle Management: Own end-to-end dispute handling by serving as a liaison between Card Members, merchants, and back-office teams to ensure accurate case setup, timely communication, and reduced resolution timelines. Leverage expertise in re-dispute management through thorough review of prior cases, merchant responses, and new evidence to drive effective case re-evaluation and resolution. Root Cause Analysis & Process Optimization: Apply investigative methodologies to identify systemic dispute patterns, enhancing process efficiency and minimizing repeat interactions. Partner with internal teams to refine dispute resolution frameworks, and initiate CMA (Card Member Agreement) research when case behavior indicates inconsistency with terms and conditions. Customer Advocacy & Experience Enhancement: Champion the Card Members perspective by delivering empathetic communication, clear guidance, and transparent resolutions throughout the dispute processfostering trust, loyalty, and superior customer experience. Qualifications Minimum Requirements: Computer literate, able to navigate through multiple computer systems and applications simultaneously, with speed and accuracy. Natural communicator who can demonstrate active listening skills and adapt conversation to suit the situation and the Card Members communication style. A problem-solver to efficiently evaluate Card Member issues and offer the best inventive solutions with a view to resolving the first contact. A capacity to learn, willingness to try new things, ability to incorporate feedback and agility through change and difficult situations. Resilience is needed to efficiently manage a steady stream of diverse customer portfolios, while balancing performance to meet a variety of metrics. title: Executive
description:
Job Description Quality Executive / QC Executive 
 Position: Quality Executive / QC Executive 
 Department: Quality 
 Location: Delhi Warehouse 
 Reporting To: Quality Manager / Head Quality 
 Experience: 37 Years 
 Qualification: Diploma / Graduate; Engineering or Quality-related qualification preferred 
 
 1. Job Purpose 
 The Quality Executive will be responsible for ensuring end-to-end quality control at the Delhi Warehouse. The role will primarily focus on Pre-Dispatch Inspection (PDI), return product inspection and segregation, customer complaint investigation, reduction of product returns and bad inventory, and continuous quality improvement . The individual will act as the primary Quality representative at the warehouse and work closely with Warehouse, SCM, Sales, Customer Service, Factory, and Quality teams to ensure that only quality-approved products are dispatched to customers. 
 
 2. Key Responsibilities 
 
 A. Pre-Dispatch Inspection (PDI) 
 Conduct 100% Pre-Dispatch Inspection (PDI) of sofas and mattresses before dispatch from the Delhi warehouse. Inspect products for: Appearance and finishing Dimensions and construction Stitching and upholstery Packing and packaging condition Labels and MRP Product specifications and details Other applicable quality parameters Ensure all products comply with defined company quality standards and SOPs before dispatch. Identify, hold, and segregate defective products before they reach customers. Maintain accurate PDI records and inspection status in Google Sheets / Microsoft Excel . Immediately escalate recurring or critical defects to the Quality and concerned functional teams. Ensure no product is dispatched without the required quality approval. 
 
 B. Return Product Inspection & Segregation 
 Inspect all returned mattresses, sofas, and accessories received at the Delhi warehouse. Assess the physical condition, defect, usage, and repairability of returned products. Categorize returned products as: Reworkable: Products that can be restored to saleable condition through approved rework. Non-Reworkable: Products that cannot be economically or technically restored and should be classified as bad inventory. Ensure proper physical segregation, tagging, and identification of reworkable and non-reworkable products. Maintain complete return inspection records, including: Return reason Defect type Product condition Root cause, wherever identifiable Rework requirement Final disposition Coordinate with relevant teams for timely rework, release, disposal, or closure of returned inventory. Monitor rework quality before products are released back to saleable inventory. 
 
 C. Customer Complaint Investigation & Market Visits 
 Visit customer locations, whenever required, to investigate quality-related complaints. Conduct on-site product inspection and identify the actual cause of the complaint. Distinguish between manufacturing defects, handling/storage damage, installation-related issues, usage-related concerns, and other causes. Prepare detailed inspection/visit reports supported by photographs, observations, findings, and recommendations. Coordinate with Sales, Customer Service, Warehouse, Factory, and Quality teams for appropriate resolution. Track repeated customer complaints and identify areas requiring corrective and preventive action. Provide timely technical inputs to support complaint closure. 
 
 D. Return & Bad Inventory Reduction 
 Take ownership of reducing overall warehouse returns and bad/non-reworkable inventory . Analyze return data and identify major product-, defect-, and reason-wise trends. Identify recurring issues and work with cross-functional teams to eliminate root causes. Monitor rework recovery and maximize conversion of reworkable returns into saleable inventory. Drive corrective actions to prevent repeat defects and avoid unnecessary returns. Monitor product-wise and defect-wise return trends. Prepare periodic reports covering: Return % Rework % Non-Reworkable % Bad Inventory Major defect categories Corrective action status 
 
 E. Warehouse Quality Control 
 Ensure compliance with company-defined quality standards, SOPs, and work instructions. Conduct regular quality checks on: Product handling Storage conditions Stacking FIFO practices Packing Loading and unloading Dispatch practices Identify potential quality risks within warehouse operations and initiate timely corrective action. Ensure proper handling of mattresses, sofas, and accessories to prevent transit or warehouse damage. Support internal and external quality audits. Participate in quality improvement and process improvement initiatives. 
 
 F. Data Management & MIS Reporting 
 Maintain accurate and up-to-date quality records using Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets . Maintain records related to: PDI inspections Product returns Reworkable / Non-Reworkable products Customer complaints Market visits Bad inventory Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA) Product-wise trends Defect-wise trends Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly quality MIS reports. Analyze quality data and highlight key issues, trends, and improvement opportunities to management. Prepare presentations and quality reports using Microsoft PowerPoint . Maintain data accuracy, completeness, and timely reporting. Update relevant quality information in SAP , wherever applicable. 
 
 3. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

 4. Required Skills & Competencies 
 
 Technical Skills 
 Good knowledge of Quality Control / Quality Assurance activities. Experience in the mattress, sofa, furniture, upholstery, home-furnishing, or similar industry will be preferred. Good understanding of mattress and sofa construction, materials, upholstery, finishing, and common quality defects. Strong knowledge of: Inspection and defect identification Product segregation Root Cause Analysis (RCA) Corrective & Preventive Action (CAPA) Quality documentation Quality data analysis Good working knowledge of: Microsoft Excel Microsoft Word Microsoft PowerPoint Google Sheets SAP Ability to prepare and analyze MIS reports and present quality trends to management. 
 
 Behavioural Competencies 
 Strong ownership and accountability. Excellent observation and attention to detail. Strong problem-solving and analytical skills. Ability to work independently at a warehouse location. Good communication and interpersonal skills. Effective cross-functional coordination. Willingness to travel for customer complaint investigations. Ability to handle difficult quality issues and drive timely closure. Strong focus on prevention rather than only defect detection . Result-oriented approach with a focus on reducing returns and bad inventory. 
 
 5. Qualification & Experience 
 Qualification: Diploma / Graduate in a relevant discipline. Diploma / Degree in Engineering, Quality, Production, Mechanical, or a related field will be preferred. Experience: 37 years of relevant experience in Quality Control / Quality Assurance. Experience in mattress, sofa, furniture, upholstery, home-furnishing, or related manufacturing/warehouse operations will be preferred. 
 
 6. Key Interfaces 
 The Quality Executive will work closely with: Warehouse Operations Supply Chain / SCM Sales Customer Service Factory / Manufacturing Quality Team Logistics / Dispatch Other relevant support functions 
 
 7. Overall Role Expectation 
 The Quality Executive will be the primary Quality representative at the Delhi Warehouse and will be responsible for end-to-end warehouse quality performance. The role is not limited to identifying defects. The individual is expected to: Prevent defective products from being dispatched. Ensure proper inspection and disposition of returned products. Maximize recovery of reworkable inventory. Minimize bad/non-reworkable inventory. Reduce customer complaints and repeat complaints. Identify and eliminate recurring quality issues. Drive corrective and preventive actions. Ensure accurate quality data and timely MIS reporting. Continuously improve the overall quality performance of the Delhi Warehouse.

We handle end-to-end social media management — from scripting and video production to content calendars, brand strategy, and performance marketing — for a portfolio of high-ticket clients across industries including F&B, fintech, legal-tech, automotive, lifestyle, government, and personal branding. We are a lean, high-output team that believes in entertainment-first advertising, culturally resonant storytelling, and holding ourselves to insanely high standards of accountability. If you live and breathe video, can turn a brief into a story, and care about every single cut on your timeline — keep reading. THE ROLE As a Senior Video Editor at Deeshuumm, you are not just an editor — you are a visual storyteller and a creative force. You don't wait for a shot list to be handed to you — you think about what the shot list should be. You don't just cut footage — you shape narratives, build emotion, and craft content that makes people stop scrolling. You will shoot on-site at client locations, bring your own creative inputs to every project, and own the visual output from concept to camera to final export. You are expected to think like a filmmaker, execute like a machine, and push the creative bar higher with every piece of content you deliver. This is not a "just edit what we give you" role. If you don't have opinions about storytelling, pacing, and what makes content great — this isn't for you. MANDATORY REQUIREMENT You MUST have your own laptop/device capable of running professional video editing software (Premiere Pro / Final Cut Pro / DaVinci Resolve). This is non-negotiable and a prerequisite for this role. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Own the end-to-end video production process — from creative ideation and shoot planning to on-site filming and post-production. Shoot clean, cinematic, professional footage on-site at client locations — events, brand shoots, behind-the-scenes, testimonials, product demos, founder stories, and reel content. Bring strong creative inputs during brainstorming and pre-production — suggest visual treatments, camera angles, transitions, narrative arcs, and storytelling approaches. Edit short-form content (Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts) and long-form content (YouTube videos, brand films, campaign films) with sharp pacing, emotional depth, and platform-native style. Develop a signature visual language for each client brand — ensuring consistency in tone, color grading, motion style, and editing rhythm across all content. Handle advanced color grading, professional sound design, subtitling, motion graphics, and text overlays. Collaborate closely with the Brand Managers, scriptwriters, and creative team to translate briefs into compelling visual stories. Take ownership of content quality — if a video goes live, your name is on it. No excuses, no "I was just told to edit this." Stay obsessively updated on trending editing styles, cinematic techniques, sound design, and platform-specific content formats. Manage, organize, and back up all raw footage, project files, and final exports with a systematic, professional workflow. Travel to client shoot locations across Gurugram and Delhi NCR as required. Maintain and care for company camera and production equipment during on-site shoots. Mentor junior editors and interns when required, setting quality benchmarks for the production team. WHO YOU ARE 1–2 years of hands-on experience in professional video editing and shooting (agency, production house, or creator economy experience preferred). Proficient in Adobe Premiere Pro or Final Cut Pro. DaVinci Resolve, After Effects, or motion graphics skills are a strong plus. You are a storyteller first, editor second — you understand narrative structure, emotional pacing, and how to build a story that holds attention. Comfortable behind a camera — DSLR/mirrorless shooting experience with a solid understanding of framing, composition, lighting, and audio. You have creative opinions and you voice them. You push back on weak ideas and bring better ones to the table. Deep understanding of what works on Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn, and Twitter — not as a viewer, but as a creator who reverse-engineers virality. Strong command over Hinglish/Hindi content style — you understand how India consumes content on the internet. Ability to work under tight deadlines without compromising quality — we run on Content Quick Commerce timelines. Highly organized and process-driven — your project files, folders, and exports are clean and systematic. Self-starter mentality. You don't wait to be told what to do — you see what needs to be done and you do it. Comfortable traveling to shoot locations across Gurugram/Delhi NCR at short notice. Bonus: Experience with CapCut, Canva Video, AI-based video tools, or motion design. Bonus: A personal YouTube channel, Instagram page, or any proof that you create content because you love it — not just because you're paid to. WHAT YOU MUST BRING Your own laptop/workstation capable of professional video editing (minimum 16GB RAM, SSD, dedicated GPU preferred). This is a mandatory requirement for the role. A showreel or portfolio of previous work — client projects, freelance work, personal content, YouTube videos, anything that shows your craft and creative thinking. A hunger to build a career in visual storytelling, take radical ownership, and grow inside a high-output creative agency. WHY JOIN DEESHUUMM? Work directly with the founders — zero bureaucracy, maximum creative freedom. Shoot and edit for real, high-ticket brands across diverse industries from day one — fintech, F&B, legal-tech, lifestyle, government, and more. Be part of a team building at the intersection of creativity and AI — we don't just follow trends, we set them. A culture of radical ownership and accountability where your work directly impacts brand outcomes. Collaborate with a 40+ member creative team with real industry experience. Office located in DLF Phase 2, Gurugram — the heart of the city's business district. HOW TO APPLY Send your resume along with a showreel or links to videos you've shot and edited. If you have a YouTube channel, Instagram page with your edits, or a portfolio of any kind — even better. We don't care about certificates. Show us what you've made. Deeshuumm Ventures Private Limited | DLF Phase 2, Gurugram, Haryana Do the Deeshuumm

title: Sports Video Editor
description:
Sports Video Editor 
 LOCATION - Gurgaon
 EXPERIENCE - 2-5 years
 TYPE - Full-time 
 APPLY TO - hr@rskve.com 
 
 ABOUT PLUS.FAN 
 Plus.Fan is a fan experience platform for teams, clubs and leagues. We give sports organisations the technology 
 to sell memberships and insider subscriptions behind-the-scenes content, player access and exclusive 
 experiences that turn followers into a connected, paying fan base, and open up revenue beyond tickets and 
 merchandise. 
 We work with clubs and leagues internationally, including York City FC and Carrick Rangers, and are now building 
 out our India operation across various sporting properties. Alongside the platform, we are expanding into sports 
 content and social media for our international and national clients. 
 THE ROLE 
 We are looking for a video editor who can turn raw sports footage into content people actually want to watch. 
 This is an editing-first role. You will edit matchday footage, player stories, interviews, behind-the-scenes content, 
 fan moments and branded campaigns - everything from fast-turnaround Reels to longer-form sports films. You 
 will take a brief and raw footage, find the story, make the creative calls and deliver a finished edit. 
 If editing is not your core skill, this is not the role for you. 
 WHAT YOU'LL DO 
 Editing & Storytelling 
 Develop short-form and long-form sports content for Plus.Fan and its partner teams, leagues, athletes and 
 brands. 
Edit Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts and other vertical, social-first formats. 
Edit longer-form work - interviews, player features, documentaries, branded films and match stories. 
Turn unstructured footage - matches, training, interviews, BTS, fan interactions, events - into stories with a 
 clear narrative flow. Find the strong moments in raw footage: the quote, the reaction, the emotion, the storyline nobody briefed 
 you on. 
 Build a hook in the opening seconds and hold attention through to the end. Make the calls on pacing, cuts, music, sound design, transitions and graphics. 
Know the difference between editing for retention in short-form and building structure across long-form. 
 Structure longer pieces so narrative flow and audience interest hold across the full runtime. 
 Work scorecards, player stats and match data into edits without making them look like spreadsheets. 
 Matchday & Quick Turnaround 
 Work across live matches, tournaments, training sessions and sporting events. 
 Deliver matchday edits against tight sporting timelines, often while the event is still running. 
 Cut player highlights, match moments, celebrations, reactions and fan moments. 
Prioritise and organise large volumes of footage efficiently under event pressure. 
 
 
 Work with on-ground teams to flag what needs turning around first. 
Operate at the speed and unpredictability that sports content demands. 
 Motion Graphics & Craft 
Create title cards, lower thirds, player introductions, end frames and text animation. 
Know when graphics lift a story and when they just clutter it. Adapt editing style to different teams, athletes and campaigns while holding brand consistency. Hold a high bar on typography, composition, sound and colour. 
 Collaboration & Delivery 
Work with the social, creative and account teams to understand the objective behind each piece. 
Translate a brief into an editing approach - and bring your own ideas when you review footage. 
Repurpose long-form footage into multiple short-form assets and platform-specific edits. 
Create different cuts and versions of the same content for different platforms, audiences and campaigns. 
Take feedback and turn revisions around fast. 
Keep project files, footage and versions organised across multiple parallel projects. 
 WHAT YOU'LL BRING 
 Essential. If you don't have these, this is not the right role. 
 2-5 years of professional editing experience in sports, entertainment, media, advertising or digital content. 
Hands-on experience across both short-form and long-form work. 
A portfolio or showreel of work you personally edited. 
Command of Premiere Pro or an equivalent professional platform. 
Working knowledge of After Effects or another motion graphics tool. 
Solid grasp of audio editing, sound design and colour correction. 
A feel for storytelling, pacing and visual rhythm - and for what makes someone stop scrolling. 
The ability to take an edit from brief to final delivery without hand-holding. 
Genuine interest in sport, and familiarity with how sports content is consumed on social media & 
 subscription-based platforms. 
 WHAT WOULD SET YOU APART 
 Desirable, not essential. Any of these will strengthen your application. 
Experience with sports teams, leagues, franchises or athletes. 
Live sports or matchday editing experience. 
Documentary, interview or branded film work. 
Advanced motion graphics or animation - 2D/3D, data visualisation, broadcast-style packages. 
Familiarity with AI-assisted editing and production tools. 
Basic shooting, photography or graphic design skills. 
 THE KIND OF EDITOR WE WANT 
 Not someone who knows how to operate editing software. Someone with creative judgement. 
 Someone who can look at two hours of footage and work out: What's the story? What's the hook? What's worth 
 keeping? Where should this move faster? What music fits? Where does the emotion land? What will make 
 someone stop scrolling? 
 You should be able to take a brief and figure out how to execute it, rather than needing every cut and transition 
 prescribed. 
 
 
 WORKING HERE 
 This is a high-ownership startup environment. You will get: 
 
 Hands-on exposure to professional sports teams, leagues and athletes 
 Real matchday and on-ground sports exposure 
 Range across short-form and long-form sports content 
 National and international sporting projects 
 Work spanning fan engagement, social media and sports marketing campaigns 
 During sporting seasons, priorities shift quickly and turnarounds get tight. You should enjoy that rather than 
 tolerate it. 
 HOW TO APPLY 
 Show us what you can edit. 
 Send your resume and portfolio to hr@rskve.com. Portfolio may include: 
 Examples of your short-form edits. 
 Examples of your long-form edits. 
 Sports work and motion graphics work, if you have it. 
 Please state your specific contribution on each project. Youll be evaluated on demonstrated editing ability and 
 portfolio quality.

**Job Title\-** 
 IND Testing Coordinator II
   

  

**Solution Line\-** 
 Health Solutions
   

  

**Position type\-** 
 Full Time
   

  

**Work Location\-** 
 Gurgaon

* Hybrid model – minimum 50% work from office is mandatory.

 8am to 5pm
   

  

**People Manager role:** 
 No
   

  

**Required Education And Certifications Critical For The Role\-**
 Any Graduate
   

  

**Required Years Of Experience –**
 6\-8 years of experience in Relevant field
   

  

**AON IS IN THE BUSINESS OF BETTER DECISIONS**
 At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world.
   

  

 As an organization, we are committed as one firm to our purpose, united through trust as one inclusive, diverse team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.
   

  

**Information About The Business**
 Aon Health and Benefits takes a long\-term view of benefits management that aims to help companies achieve a balance between using benefits as a retention tool and managing escalating costs. These offerings include end\-to\-end solutions to benefits management, alignment of your benefit plans with corporate strategy and policies, considerable purchasing leverage, systematic and structured approach.
   

  

**General Description Of Role**
 IND Testing Coordinator II is responsible for IAT test plan creation \& execution, UAT walkthrough \& coordination, documenting ongoing operations processes, implementation reporting and production of vendor, payroll and client reports during first month of go\-live. Analyse and assign defects, daily report\-out during IAT \& UAT. Conducting Service Centre and Admin trainings. Managing small Renewal projects and client management during initial phase of stabilization phase. Should be able to manage large volume of clients on regional/Global level. Should be able to mentor TC1 role people so they can deliver quality output in client UATs.
   

  

**JOB RESPONSIBILITIES (List 6\-10 Major Responsibilities In The Role)**
* Test strategy, Planning \& Execution
* Test Strategy kick off with System Analyst/Business Analyst to ensure no gaps in technical design specification
* Create detailed test plan using standard/agreed template to capture all scenarios in IAT to ensure defects are not raised during UAT
* Work with others/testing resources to close any gaps identified on testing documents and facilitate lessons learnt team discussions
* Review and analyze system specifications
* Collaborate with Configuration team to develop effective strategies and test plans
* Execute test cases (manual or automated) and analyze results
* Create logs to document testing phases and defects
* Report bugs and errors to development/configuration team.
* Conduct post\-release/ post\-implementation/Regression testing
* Work with cross\-functional teams to ensure quality throughout the implementation project
* Work closely with Project Managers to review the testing timelines and ensure testing resources are secured
* Drive and execute on overall UAT and end\-to\-end system testing strategy with client
* Operations \& Helpdesk
* Create \& Impart training plans for new implementations
* Work closely with Service delivery Managers to work on Process Maps \& Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs)
* Work closely with Testing team/Ops team to close all the workstreams on time \& make sure Ops resources are engaged throughout the project
* File walkthrough sessions to be conducted well in advance with Ops and files needs to be audited for the first 1\-2 months before Ops signs\-off
* Work on Ops handover checklist and make sure there is no open items during handover
* Continuous Improvements
* Lead the innovation/process improvement activity at client or team level in order to have efficiency gain.
* Build colleagues' acumen on solutions, financials and time management resulting in the ability to articulate key financial measures within our business. Drive consistent and clear communications around roles, responsibilities and goals to achieve
* Learn \& develop new skills as demanded by role
* Relationship building
* Contribute to positive team spirit by creating participating in all team engagement activities
* Teamwork\- Work to establish offshore resource relationships and knowledge of database structure and reporting capabilities
* Act as a backup of PM/DA/SA/BA \& provide full support in absence of the key members of the project.
* Projects \& Client management
* Manage complex AE and work closely with Client managers/SDMs to ensure successful execution of renewals.
* Manage clients and support CMs/SDMs during initial phase of operations activities.
* Understanding all overall SDLC process
* Understand the product well for demonstration
* Should be sound with Teamwork, Time Management, Analytical Skills
* Excellent communication skills
* Good to have good Operations experience


**SKILLS/COMPETENCIES REQUIRED** 
 (List 4\-8 skills required to get the job done):
   

  

* Ability to document and troubleshoot errors and rapidly learn and test new features.
* Think analytically and logically.
* Envision business situations.
* Stimulate curiosity and creativity.
* Effective Business writing
* Project Management
* Quality Six sigma
* Proficient with word and excel
* STLC, HPQC, UFT


**How We Support Our Colleagues**
 In addition to our comprehensive benefits package, we are proud to be an equal opportunity workforce. At Aon, we believe a diverse workforce is an innovative workforce. Our agile, inclusive environment allows colleagues to manage their wellbeing and work/life balance while empowering you to be your authentic self.
   

  

 Furthermore, all colleagues enjoy two “Global Wellbeing Days” each year, encouraging them to take time to focus on themselves. We offer a variety of workstyle options through our Smart Working model, but we also recognize that flexibility goes beyond just the place of work... and we are all for it!
   

  

 Our continuous learning culture inspires and equips colleagues to learn, share and grow, helping them achieve their fullest potential. As a result, Aon colleagues are more connected, more relevant and more valued.

description:
**Overview**
**CAREERS TO SMILE ABOUT**
 At PepsiCo, you’ll discover a place where our mission is to create smiles around the world. With a portfolio of more than 500 beloved brands including, Gatorade, Lay’s and Quaker, our work touches millions of people every day.
   

  

 At the heart of the company is a team of thinkers, creators, and problem\-solvers who collaborate to innovate and turn ideas into action. Driven by innovation and a focus on creating joyful moments through food and drinks, our decisions are guided by consumer centricity, creating opportunities for our associates to do meaningful work and make a lasting impact in the communities we serve.
   

  

 Whatever your role, you’ll be part of a global community that values your ideas and empowers you to make an impact, on your career and on the world around you.
   

  

 Our product portfolio, which includes 22 of the world's most iconic brands, such as Sabritas, Gamesa, Quaker, Pepsi, Gatorade and Sonrics, has been a part of Mexican homes for more than 116 years.
   

  

 A career at PepsiCo means working in a culture where all people are welcome. Here, you can dare to be you. No matter who you are, where you're from, or who you love, you can always influence the people around you and make a positive impact in the world.
   

  

**Know more: PepsiCoJobs**
**Join PepsiCo, dare for better.**
**Responsibilities**
**The Opportunity**
 The role is responsible for designing and building a vision of the Future RGM Capabilities, to enable organization to achieve Faster, Stronger and Better objectives, delivering sustainable profitable growth. It involves 360 assessment of RGM best practices available internally and externally, working with Commercial and S\&T leadership designing the strategic framework, contracting test \& learn with International markets, alignment across functions and the OUs on embedding Future RGM into the roadmaps.
   

  

 Additionally, that position will lead RGM strategic projects delivery to better inform RGM strategic priorities and Big Bets (e.g. external benchmarking). And support the RGM Leadership Team with materials for senior forums.
   

  

 The incumbent will collaborate across International, US, OU RGM teams. And cross\-functionally with Dx, GTM, S\&T, Sales, Marketing, Finance, and Supply Chain to get inputs, develop and execute RGM Future Capabilities vision.
   

  

**Your Impact**
 As International RGM Future Capabilities Director your scope would consist of
   

  

* Build a clear vision of Future RGM capabilities and the trends (channel, customer, consumer, data, digital) that will underpin these:
* Define implications for relative importance of price, promo, mix, trade.
* Define implications for how PEP will leverage RGM levers to grow in this context.
* Define implications for PEP RGM capabilities (across digital tools, processes, capabilities).
* Prioritize key terrains based on potential for PEP growth (and investment required).
* Reverse engineer the steps needed to build and integrate capabilities into individual OU maturity road maps.
* Build internal test \& learn agenda across international regions and market OUs, coordinate \& codify learning.
* Establish a framework to capture RGM Future Capabilities inputs:
* Codify internal best practices across price, promo, mix, trade investments.
* Bring together test and learn experience from global markets.
* Leverage available and open external sources.
* Lead External Best Practice Sharing with non\-compete CPGs, analytics agencies, consulting firms etc.
* Lead internal test \& learn agenda across international regions and market OUs, coordinate \& codify learning.
* Lead RGM, Commercial and S\&T cross\-functional teams to set up the ambition to scale successful tests.
* Build business case to scale successful tests.
* Partner with S\&T to impact our digital strategy and ensure digital roadmap integrates functional priorities.
* Deliver Strategic Projects in support of RGM Capability Strategy, coordinating cross functional sprint teams:
* Examples: external benchmarking, Dynamic Pricing, Promo Personalization.
* Work with PEP Corporate \& Commercial Strategy, plus External Consulting firms where appropriate.
* Lead RGM PMO process in collaboration with RGM teams, Commercial and S\&T:
* Work with OU teams and S\&T to link digital roadmaps with overarching RGM maturity progression plans.
* Work with DX, GTM and WCCE teams to ensure that cross CGG plans drive overall OU maturity in a joined\-up manner.
* Support H2/3 Big Bets definition and alignment processes to ensure that Marketing, Commercial and OU pipelines are sufficient to deliver business algorithm.
* Support AoP processes to ensure that OU RGM roadmaps are aligned and integrated with OU \& Global processes.
* Support the RGM Leadership Team with materials for senior forums (ad\-hoc):
* Senior leader \& Corporate updates \- e.g. International CCO / OpComm, RGM Council, SMM, External BoD etc.


**Qualifications**
**Who Are We Looking For?**
* 12\+ years experience preferably from top tier consulting or within a top 5 FMCG Sales, Commercial and Finance, Snacks anchor markets experience is an advantage.
* 5\+ years experience in RGM.
* Fluency in English.
* Knowledgeable of the latest trends in RGM, customers, consumers and shoppers landscape.
* Excellent story telling and presentation skills. Experienced presenter to senior stakeholders.
* Ability to articulate complex concepts in clear, simple \& logical terms \& build compelling presentations \& professional communications (in English language).
* Strong persuasion and influencing skills – cross\-functional and at Senior leadership team level.
* Proven ability to lead cross\-functional projects: Commercial, Business Development, Finance, Insights, Marketing and Innovation etc.
* Self\-starter – able to drive progress in an ambiguous environment,
* Strong leadership and change management skills.
* Excellent networking skills: build multi\-markets and multi\-functions networks, engage cross\-functional teams, create an ongoing feedback loop.


 If this is an opportunity that interests you, we encourage you to apply even if you do not meet 100% of the requirements.
   

  

**What can you expect from us:**
* Opportunities to learn and develop every day through a wide range of programs.
* Internal digital platforms that promote self\-learning.
* Development programs according to Leadership skills.
* Specialized training according to the role.
* Learning experiences with internal and external providers.
* We love to celebrate success, which is why we have recognition programs for seniority, behavior, leadership, moments of life, among others.
* Financial wellness programs that will help you reach your goals in all stages of life.
* A flexibility program that will allow you to balance your personal and work life, adapting your working day to your lifestyle.
* And because your family is also important to us, they can also enjoy benefits such as our Wellness Line, thousands of Agreements and Discounts, Scholarship programs for your children, Aid Plans for different moments of life, among others.


 We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We respect and value diversity as a work force and innovation for the organization.

 We are currently looking for a
 **Consultant**

Our Due Diligence professionals work with clients to recognize their business needs and are able to provide analysis that is critical to their investment decisions.
   

  

**Day\-to\-day Responsibilities**
* Independently reviewing data room information and collating data pertinent to financial analysis.

* Presenting analysis on quality of earnings, working capital and debt like items preparing the report and participating in Client discussions
* Assisting in identifying issues for purchase price reductions, deal restructuring, or deal termination
* Assisting clients in identifying pre and post\-acquisition transaction issues
* Supporting VP/ Director in identifying new business opportunities and developing long\-term business relationships
* Assisting the Practice Leader in managing pipeline, staffing, engagement planning, team coordination and timely delivery of financial due diligence engagements
* Managing and contributing to complex areas of the report\-writing process
* Working with cross\-border teams including colleagues in the US and Europe


**Essential Traits**
* Chartered Accountant or MBA with 2\-3 years of relevant due diligence experience in assisting private equity and strategic buyers
* Public accounting experience
* Demonstrated superior analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Demonstrated interpersonal and client relationships skills
* Proven written and verbal communication skills
* Demonstrated proficiency in Microsoft Office, with focus on Word, Power Point and Excel
* Flexibility with work hours and to travel, as needed
